pupuk-organik-cair-pengertian-sifat-kara.en:
In the world of agriculture, fertilizer is an important factor to support the growth and development of plants. Without adequate nutritional support, plants will be susceptible to pests and disease, resulting in the quality and quantity of harvests decreasing.

In general, fertilizer is divided into two types, namely chemical fertilizer and organic fertilizer. Of the two, organic fertilizer is increasingly recommended because it is environmentally friendly and does not damage the soil or water sources. One form of organic fertilizer that is now widely used is liquid organic fertilizer (POC).

Understanding Liquid Organic Fertilizer

Liquid organic fertilizer (POC) is liquid fertilizer produced from the fermentation or decomposition of natural ingredients. Based on research published in Journal of Scientific Service and Innovation, POC raw materials usually come from organic waste such as plant residues, animal waste, and human waste which is rich in nutrients.

POC contains two main groups of nutrients:

  • Macro nutrients: carbon (C), phosphorus (P), oxygen (O), hydrogen (H), potassium (K), calcium (Ca), and magnesium (Mg).

  • Micronutrients: iron (Fe), manganese (Mn), zinc (Zn), copper (Cu), boron (B), molybdenum (Mo), and chlorine (Cl).

Apart from that, POC also contains bioactive compounds such as vitamins and enzymes resulting from the activity of microorganisms during the fermentation process. This content is useful for increasing plant metabolism while strengthening resistance to less than ideal environmental conditions.

POC can be applied directly to leaves, stems and flowers because plant tissue (especially stomata) is able to absorb liquid nutrients quickly. This fertilizer is very effective for use in the initial growth phase and the vegetative to generative transition period, when the plant begins to flower or bear fruit.

Properties and Characteristics of Liquid Organic Fertilizer

Even though it is in liquid form, the properties of POC are not much different from solid organic fertilizer. Some of the main characteristics of POC include:

  1. In liquid form
    The liquid form makes it easier to absorb nutrients both through the roots and leaves.

  2. Complete nutrient content
    POC provides macro and micro nutrients that plants need throughout their life cycle.

  3. Easy to apply
    Can be sprayed on leaves, stems, flowers, or sprinkled on the ground.

  4. Quickly absorbed by plants
    Nutrients go directly into plant tissue, so the results are visible more quickly than solid fertilizers.

  5. Economical and environmentally friendly
    Can be made from household or agricultural organic waste, while helping waste management.

  6. Improves soil fertility
    Helps improve soil structure, increases organic matter content, and strengthens water holding capacity.

  7. No pungent odor
    If fermented properly, POC only has a characteristic fermentation smell, not a rotten smell.

  8. Suppresses plant diseases
    Contains good microorganisms that are able to suppress the growth of disease-causing pathogens.

  9. neutral or slightly acidic pH
    Generally a pH of 6–7, ideal for most plants.

  10. Improve the quality of the harvest
    Fruit and vegetables are fresher, more natural and have a longer shelf life.

Advantages and Disadvantages of Liquid Organic Fertilizer

Compared to solid organic fertilizer, POC has the main advantage of ease of use. Just by spraying or watering, plants can immediately absorb nutrients.

However, POC is not recommended as a long-term main fertilizer, because its liquid nature makes nutrients easily leached by rainwater or erosion.

Advantages of POC

  • Easy to make from surrounding organic ingredients.

  • Contains macro and micro nutrients, although in limited levels.

  • Practical, economical and quickly absorbed by plants.

  • Helps the weathering of soil minerals.

  • Increases cation exchange capacity (CEC).

  • Improves soil structure and aeration.

  • Be a source of energy for beneficial soil microbes.

Proper Packaging for POC

bung-karno-dan-kisah-kisah-lucu-di-awal-.zh:
印度尼西亚独立的开始不仅充满了斗争和英雄主义的故事。在建国的精神之中，也诞生了许多搞笑可爱的事件，这些事件源于人们的纯真和当时的紧急情况。

1.自由，但你为什么还要花钱买票？

苏加诺总统曾经讲述过一个独特的事件。公告发布几天后，一些居民登上了火车。当售票员来收票时，他们惊呆了。
“为什么，为什么要付钱？我们已经独立了！”他们的抗议很简单。
显然，有一种观点认为独立会自动让一切免费，包括乘坐火车。

2.印度尼西亚共和国总统的第一辆“官方”汽车

建国后，选举总统，但没有国家元首的官方交通工具。几个年轻人前去寻找。
最后，他们找到了一辆属于日本官员的豪华别克轿车。其中一名年轻人苏迪罗要求汽车司机交出钥匙，然后让他回家。
该车成为印尼总统的第一辆官方用车。

3.邦卡诺的第一笔订单：50 串

1945 年 8 月 18 日 PPKI 审判结束后的晚上，邦卡诺步行回家。路边，沙爹鸡肉的香味诱惑了他。
饥饿的肚子让新总统发出了“第一道命令”：
“给我沙爹鸡肉，50串！”
蹲在路边的新总统，津津有味地吃着沙爹。

4. 1.5小时快速晋升副官

邦卡诺刚上任时没有助手。一名年轻人被任命并立即被授予中尉军衔。他当然很高兴。
但是，总统的顾问们认为这个级别太低了。 “领导1000万人民的荷兰女王朱莉安娜只有一名上校作为助手。当人多的印尼总统只有一名中尉作为助手时？”他说。
Bung Karno 同意了。年轻人被叫了回来。 “从现在开始，你的军衔就是少校。”总统说道。
短短一个半小时，助手就升了两级。据邦卡诺说，这样的事情在革命期间很正常。

从这些故事中，我们知道独立不仅是奋斗和牺牲，更是欢笑和温暖。即使在困难的情况下，人们的幽默感和天真无邪提醒我们，建设一个国家需要一颗轻松的心、极大的热情和真诚的微笑。
bung-karno-dan-kisah-kisah-lucu-di-awal-.en:
The beginning of Indonesian independence was not only marked by stories of struggle and heroism. In the midst of the spirit of building the nation, there were also many funny and adorable events that were born from the innocence of the people and the emergency situation at that time.

1. Freedom, But Why Are You Still Paying For Tickets?

President Soekarno once told of a unique incident. A few days after the proclamation, a number of residents boarded the train. When the conductor came to collect the fare, they were shocked.
“Why, why pay? We are already independent!” their protest was plain.
Apparently, there is an opinion that independence automatically makes everything free, including train rides.

2. The First "Official" Car of the President of the Republic of Indonesia

After the country was founded, the president was elected, but there was no official vehicle for the head of state. A number of young men went searching.
Finally, they found a luxury Buick car belonging to a Japanese official. Sudiro, one of the youths, asked the car driver to hand over the keys, then asked him to go home.
The car became the first official vehicle for the President of Indonesia.

3. Bung Karno's First Order: 50 Skewers

In the evening after the PPKI trial on August 18 1945, Bung Karno walked home. On the side of the road, the smell of chicken satay tempted him.
His hungry stomach made the new president issue his “first order”:
“Give me chicken satay, 50 skewers!” he said.
While squatting on the side of the road, the country's newborn president ate satay with gusto.

4. Adjutant Quickly Promoted in 1.5 Hours

When he first took office, Bung Karno did not have an aide. A young man was appointed and immediately given the rank of Lieutenant. He was certainly very happy.
However, the president's advisors considered this rank to be too low. "Queen Juliana from the Netherlands, who leads 10 million people, only has a colonel as an aide. When an Indonesian president with more people only has a lieutenant as aide?" he said.
Bung Karno agreed. The young man was called back. "From now on, your rank is major," said the president.
In just an hour and a half, the aide rose two levels. According to Bung Karno, things like this were normal during the revolution.

From these stories, we learn that independence is not only struggle and sacrifice, but also laughter and warmth. Even in difficult situations, the people's sense of humor and innocence are a reminder that building a nation requires a light heart, great enthusiasm and a sincere smile.

印度尼西亚被誉为世界上最大的螃蟹生产国之一。螃蟹拥有漫长的海岸线、广阔的水域和肥沃的红树林生态系统，是本地和出口市场的主要渔业商品之一。

以下是印度尼西亚 5 个最大的螃蟹产区：

1. 南加里曼丹

南加里曼丹以其高品质青蟹而闻名。由于红树林维护良好，Kotabaru 和 Tanah Bumbu 等地区已成为螃蟹生产中心。这里捕获和养殖的许多螃蟹都被送往出口市场，特别是软壳蟹类型，具有很高的销售价值。

2. 东加里曼丹

Kutai Kartanegara、Berau 和 Tarakan（在成为北加里曼丹之前）的沿海地区是螃蟹养殖中心。良好的水质和政府计划的支持意味着东加里曼丹的螃蟹产量持续增加。这里的许多农民开始使用现代容器来优化软蟹的生长。

3. 南苏拉威西

南苏拉威西岛，特别是庞凯普县和马罗斯县，是小蟹和泥蟹的主要生产地之一。除了海上捕捞外，利用螃蟹育肥和软壳养殖系统在这里也开始迅速发展。

4. 西爪哇

Indramayu 和 Karawang 等地区是爪哇岛上著名的红树林蟹养殖中心。由于池塘面积较大，当地农民开发了许多现代化的饲养系统，以最大限度地减少螃蟹死亡并在销售前保持质量。

5. 东爪哇

Sidoarjo、Gresik 和 Banyuwangi 地区是著名的小螃蟹和泥蟹中心。东爪哇的产品不仅满足当地市场的需求，还出口到日本、新加坡、美国等国家。

合适的容器对于养殖软壳蟹的重要性

  • 人体工程学设计 – 使螃蟹定位和水循环更容易。

  • 易于清洁 – 降低疾病风险并保持作物质量。

  • 耐用 – 适合在池塘和孵化场密集使用。

    • 通过使用正确的容器，农民可以提高效率、降低死亡率并生产出口品质的软蟹。

    结论：
    印度尼西亚的五个大螃蟹产区——南加里曼丹、东加里曼丹、南苏拉威西、西爪哇和东爪哇——已经证明了这种商品的巨大潜力。 亚洲塑料软壳蟹容器等技术支持和养殖设备是保持质量和生产力的关键，使印尼螃蟹在全球市场上更具竞争力。

Indonesia is known as one of the largest crab producing countries in the world. With a long coastline, wide waters and a fertile mangrove ecosystem, crabs are one of the leading fishery commodities, both for local and export markets.

Here are the 5 largest crab producing areas in Indonesia:

1. South Kalimantan

South Kalimantan is famous for its high quality mud crabs. Areas such as Kotabaru and Tanah Bumbu districts have become crab producing centers, thanks to their well-maintained mangrove areas. Many of the crabs caught and cultivated here are sent to the export market, especially for the soft shelled crab type which has a high selling value.

2. East Kalimantan

The coastal areas of Kutai Kartanegara, Berau and Tarakan (before becoming North Kalimantan) were centers of crab cultivation. Good water quality and support from government programs means that crab production in East Kalimantan continues to increase. Many farmers here are starting to use modern containers to optimize the growth of soft crabs.

3. South Sulawesi

South Sulawesi, especially Pangkep and Maros Regencies, is one of the main producers of small crabs and mud crabs. Apart from fishing at sea, cultivation using crab fattening and soft shell culture systems is starting to develop rapidly here.

4. West Java

Areas such as Indramayu and Karawang are known as centers for mangrove crab cultivation on the island of Java. With large pond areas, local farmers have developed many modern holding systems to minimize crab deaths and maintain quality before marketing.

5. East Java

The districts of Sidoarjo, Gresik and Banyuwangi are famous as centers for small crabs and mud crabs. Production from East Java not only meets the needs of the local market, but is also exported to countries such as Japan, Singapore and America.

The Importance of the Right Container for Cultivating Soft Shelled Crab

In cultivating soft shelled crabs (soft shelled crab), the quality of the container greatly influences the survival rate and quality of the harvest. Soft Shelled Crab Container from Asia Plastik is present as a practical and hygienic solution for storing and rearing crabs.

By using the right containers, farmers can increase efficiency, reduce mortality rates, and produce export quality soft crabs.

相似但不相同：这就是内墙涂料和外墙涂料的区别

乍一看，内墙涂料和外墙涂料看起来是一样的。颜色很吸引人，包装也差不多，也可以用来做墙。但是，别被愚弄了！根据使用环境的不同，两者具有不同的功能和特点。

1. 耐候性

外墙涂料可承受紫外线、雨水和极端温度变化。抗真菌、防褪色和防水成分使其即使全年暴露在恶劣天气下也能经久耐用。
同时，内墙涂料由于不直接暴露在室外天气，所以更注重铺展性、易清洁性和光滑的最终外观。

2. 材料成分

外墙涂料通常含有更强的丙烯酸树脂以及紫外线防护添加剂。另一方面，内墙涂料对于封闭的房间来说更安全，因为它的VOC（挥发性有机化合物）水平往往较低，因此不会产生强烈的气味或危​​害房屋居住者的健康。

3. 装饰和美观

室内涂料提供多种饰面选项：哑光、缎面、光面 - 所有这些都根据房间的美观度定制。与此同时，外墙涂料往往更局限于耐用和实用的饰面。

Similar But Not The Same: This Is The Difference Between Interior and Exterior Wall Paint

At first glance, interior and exterior wall paint looks the same. The color is attractive, the packaging is similar, and it can also be used for walls. But, don't be fooled! Both have different functions and characteristics according to their usage environment.

1. Weather Resistance

Exterior paintis designed to withstand UV rays, rain and extreme temperature changes. The anti-fungal, anti-fade, and waterproofing ingredients make it durable even if exposed to weather throughout the year.
Meanwhile interior paint focuses more on spreadability, ease of cleaning, and a smooth final appearance because it is not directly exposed to outside weather.

2. Material Composition

Exterior paint usually has stronger acrylic resins as well as UV protective additives. On the other hand, interior paint is safer for closed rooms because its VOC (volatile organic compounds) levels tend to be lower, so it does not cause a strong odor or endanger the health of the occupants of the house.

3. Finishing and Aesthetics

Interior paint offers many finishing options: matte, satin, to glossy—all tailored to the aesthetics of the room. Meanwhile, exterior paint tends to be more limited to durable and practical finishes.

Here are the various uses of glycerin, a versatile ingredient for various industries!

Glycerin or glycerol is a thick liquid compound that is colorless, odorless and has a sweet taste. Widely used in various industrial sectors because it is hygroscopic, a good solvent, and safe to use. Here are some of the uses of glycerin that you should know:

1. Cosmetics and Personal Care Industry

Glycerin acts as a natural moisturizer (humectant) in skincare products such as lotion, liquid soap and facial cream. Its function helps maintain skin moisture and keeps it smooth.

2. Pharmaceutical Industry

In the world of medicine, glycerin is used as a solvent, sweetener in syrup, and soft capsule coating. Its safety makes it an ideal choice in medical product formulations.

3. Food and Beverage Industry

Glycerin is used as a food additive (E422) to retain moisture, provide a light sweet taste, and aid texture in products such as cakes, candy, and ice cream.

4. Chemical and Textile Industry

Glycerin is used as a solvent, lubricant and anti-freeze agent in the chemical industry. In the world of textiles, glycerin is useful for softening and washing fabrics.

5. Agriculture Industry

Used in pesticide and liquid fertilizer formulations because of its ability to carry active ingredients and help absorption in plants.

从早上开始，委员会就开始准备迎接参与者。活动以共同祈祷和唱《印度尼西亚开斋节》歌曲拉开帷幕。这个庄严的时刻提醒人们，独立精神必须永远存在，不仅在庆祝活动中，而且在日常生活中。

仪式结束后，员工们一起沿着SEER工业园区的简单路线进行了健康步行。当参与者交换组委会准备的入场券时，疲惫似乎得到了回报。赞助商特别是BCA颁发的精美奖品让现场气氛更加热烈。活动间隙，还有租户和美食集市，增添了乐趣。员工们可以一边休息，一边品尝各种小吃，让本次活动不仅健康，而且温馨。

最令人期待的部分是“A Factor”人才搜寻大赛。每个部门都展示了自己最好的创造力，从歌唱、传统舞蹈、戏剧到现代舞。营销经理兼赛事评委 Evi Irawati 表示，参赛者的表演确实令人惊叹。 “我们对它们的外观产生了兴趣，它美丽而独特。非常紧凑，”他说。

到了正门抽奖时间，气氛变得更加喧闹。智能电视和折叠自行车两项大奖成功让所有参赛者屏息以待。不要忘记，另一个特殊的时刻是向最优秀的员工颁奖，作为公司对他们奉献精神的感谢。

作为组委会成员，Greatha 对本次活动的成功举办表示感谢。 “希望大家对今天的活动感到满意，希望以后能办得更好，奖品更多。”他说。

亚洲塑料工厂庆祝第 80 届印度尼西亚独立日不仅是健康步行或比赛，更是团结精神。员工互相支持、欢笑并享受每一刻，这证明可以以健康、创造性和兄弟般的方式庆祝独立。
meriah-jalan-sehat-a-factor-warnai-peray.en:
An enthusiastic atmosphere enveloped the SIER industrial area, when all Asia Plastik Factory employees gathered to celebrate Indonesia's 80th Independence Day. This year, the celebration feels special because it is packed with healthy walking activities and a talent search competition entitled "A Factor" a la X Factor.

Since morning, the committee has been preparing to welcome participants. The event opened with a joint prayer and singing the song Indonesia Raya. This solemn moment is a reminder that the spirit of independence must always be alive, not only in celebrations, but also in everyday life.

After the ceremony, employees together followed a healthy walk with a simple route around the SEER industrial complex. The tiredness seemed to pay off when the participants exchanged the door prize coupons that had been prepared by the committee. Attractive prizes from sponsors, especially BCA, made the atmosphere even more festive. In between activities, there are also tenants and a food bazaar which adds to the fun. Employees can rest while tasting various snacks, making this event not only healthy, but also warm in togetherness.

The most awaited part is the “A Factor” talent search competition. Each division displays its best creativity, from singing, traditional dance, theatrical drama, to modern dance. According to Evi Irawati, Marketing Manager and event judge, the participants' performances were truly stunning. "We became interested in seeing their appearance, it was beautiful and unique. Very compact," he said.

The atmosphere became even more noisy when it came time for the main door prize draw. Two big prizes, namely a Smart TV and a Folding Bicycle, succeeded in making all participants hold their breath with anticipation. Not to forget, another special moment is giving awards to the best employees, as a form of company appreciation for their dedication.

As the committee, Greatha expressed his gratitude for the success of this event. "Hopefully everyone is happy with today's activities. In the future, we hope it can be even better, with more prizes," he said.

The celebration of the 80th Indonesian Independence Day at the Asia Plastik Factory is not only about healthy walks or competitions, but also about the spirit of togetherness. Employees support each other, laugh and enjoy every moment, proving that independence can be celebrated in a healthy, creative and brotherly way.

20-makanan-khas-indonesia-yang-ternyata-.zh:
印度尼西亚以其非凡的烹饪财富而闻名。然而，谁能想到，在种类繁多的典型印尼美食背后，有不少菜肴显然是与荷兰文化同化的结果，甚至是殖民时期的遗产。

虽然来自国外，但这些食品却与当地风味完美融合，成为印尼人民日常生活中不可分割的一部分。你好奇什么？来吧，查看列表！

1. Cookie

谁不知道 Perkedel？这种以土豆为主的食物通常用作配菜，搭配米饭、面条和龙通。 Perkedel 来自荷兰菜，由土豆、肉和蔬菜混合而成。

2. 合法青金石

这款甜的分层蛋糕显然来自荷兰。 Lapis Legit 曾经是一种典型的荷兰夹心蛋糕，经过改良以适应当地口味，现在经常被用作典型的印度尼西亚纪念品。

3. 炖菜

“semur”这个名字来自荷兰语单词smoor，意思是沸腾。这种食物最初是用欧洲香料炖肉，但现在以其酱油和典型的印度尼西亚香料而闻名。

4. 炸丸子

炸丸子是椭圆形的油条，由土豆泥制成，里面填满肉末或蔬菜，然后油炸。 “croquette”一词源自法语 croquer，意思是“松脆的”，但通过荷兰的影响传入印度尼西亚。

5. Nastar

Nastar 是开斋节期间的必备蛋糕。此前，nastar 是迷你版的荷兰派，里面填满了苹果酱或草莓酱。由于这些水果在印尼很难买到，所以馅料换成了菠萝酱。

6. Kastengel

这款撒有奶酪的咸干蛋糕也来自荷兰。它的名字来源于单词kaas（奶酪）和stengels（茎），指的是它细长的形状。

7. Klappertaart

klappertaart 的意思是“椰子挞”，是一种典型的万鸦老甜点，是荷兰殖民时代的遗产。它由嫩椰子、牛奶和鸡蛋制成，通常在圣诞节庆祝活动期间供应。

8. Risol

Risol（原名 risoles）是一种含有肉类和蔬菜炖肉的油炸小吃。由荷兰人带来，然后用当地的粉丝或蔬菜等馅料进行修改，成为印尼人民喜爱的小吃。

9. 梭罗海峡

这道典型的梭罗菜的灵感来自于荷兰沙拉。现在，梭罗海峡具有独特的当地风味——包含牛肉、土豆、鸡蛋以及甜味和咸味的五香酱。

10。 柔和关闭

印度尼西亚版的牧羊人派或印度酱。最上层是土豆泥，里面有肉、蔬菜和粉丝。适合趁热食用。

11. Spiku

Spiku 是泗水夹心蛋糕的另一个名字，类似于青金石。这款蛋糕质地松软，层次颜色独特。最初采用荷兰蛋糕食谱。

12. 炸面包

炸面包是一种香甜可口的街头小吃。这种面包最初由荷兰人带来，后来发展为各种现代馅料，如巧克力、青豆和奶酪。

尽管起源于荷兰殖民时代，这些不同的食物已经融入了群岛的文化和口味。事实上，我们大多数人可能不知道它的起源，因为它与印度尼西亚的烹饪特征密切相关。

这一殖民遗产证明烹饪是一个文化适应的空间，可以创造出独特、正宗和自豪的新风味。那么，从上面的列表中，您最喜欢哪一个？
20-makanan-khas-indonesia-yang-ternyata-.en:
Indonesia is known for its extraordinary culinary wealth. However, who would have thought, behind the variety of typical Indonesian food, there are a number of dishes which are apparently the result of cultural acculturation with the Netherlands, and are even a legacy from the colonial period.

Even though they come from abroad, these foods have blended perfectly with local flavors and become an inseparable part of Indonesian people's daily lives. What are you curious about? Come on, check out the list!

1. Cookies

Who doesn't know perkedel? This potato-based food is often used as a side dish to accompany rice, noodles and lontong. Perkedel comes from a Dutch dish made from a mixture of potatoes, meat and vegetables.

2. Lapis Legit

This sweet layered cake apparently comes from the Netherlands. Lapis legit used to be a typical Dutch layer cake that was modified to suit local tastes, and is now often used as a typical Indonesian souvenir.

3. Stews

The name "semur" comes from the Dutch word smoor, which means to boil. This food was originally a meat stew with European spices, but is now known for its soy sauce and typical Indonesian spices.

4. Croquettes

Croquettes are oval-shaped fritters made from mashed potatoes filled with minced meat or vegetables, then fried. The word "croquette" comes from the French croquer which means "crunchy," but was introduced to Indonesia through Dutch influence.

5. Nastar

Nastar is a mandatory cake during Eid. Previously, nastar was a mini version of Dutch pie filled with apple or strawberry jam. Because it is difficult to get these fruits in Indonesia, the filling was replaced with pineapple jam.

6. Kastengel

This salty dry cake sprinkled with cheese also comes from the Netherlands. Its name comes from the words kaas (cheese) and stengels (stem), which refers to its small elongated shape.

7. Klappertaart

Meaning "coconut tart", klappertaart is a typical Manado dessert that is a legacy of the Dutch colonial era. Made from young coconut, milk and eggs, it is usually served during Christmas celebrations.

8. Risol

Risol (originally risoles) is a fried snack containing meat and vegetable ragout. Brought by the Dutch, then modified with local fillings such as vermicelli or vegetables, and became a favorite snack of Indonesian people.

9. Solo Strait

This typical Surakarta dish is inspired by the Dutch salade. Now, the Solo Strait has a unique local taste—containing beef, potatoes, eggs, and a splash of sweet and savory spiced sauce.

10. Pastel Close

Indonesian version of shepherd’s pie or indische pastei. Made from mashed potatoes as the top layer, with meat, vegetables and vermicelli filling inside. Suitable served warm.

11. Spiku

Spiku is another name for Surabaya layer cake which is similar to lapis legit. This cake has a soft texture and distinctive layer color. Originally adopted from a Dutch cake recipe.

12. Fried Bread

Fried bread is known as a sweet and filling street snack. Originally brought by the Dutch, this bread then developed with various modern fillings such as chocolate, green beans and cheese.

Even though it originates from the Dutch colonial era, these various foods have become integrated with the culture and tastes of the archipelago. In fact, most of us may not be aware of its origins because it is so closely associated with Indonesian culinary identity.

This colonial heritage proves that culinary is a space for acculturation that can create new flavors that are distinctive, authentic and proud. So, from the list above, which one is your favorite?

traffic-block-bisa-menurunkan-angka-kece.zh:
道路安全是我们的共同责任。每年，由于缺乏清晰的标志、标记或道路分隔线，都会发生数以千计的事故。那么，有助于减少事故数量的一种简单但有效的解决方案是使用交通阻塞。

什么是流量阻止？

交通路障是道路分隔线，通常由优质塑料制成，通常填充水或沙子以提供重量。该工具用于引导、限制或阻止车辆穿越危险路径。您可能经常在道路建设项目、收费出口、大型停车场看到它。

交通堵塞如何帮助减少事故？

  • 管理交通流量：
    通过正确放置，交通块可以帮助引导车辆驶入安全车道，特别是在弯道、狭窄道路或繁忙十字路口等事故多发区域。

  • 提供清晰的视觉警告：
    醒目的颜色和引人注目的形状让驾驶员在穿越有障碍物的区域时更加警惕和小心。

  • 防止进入危险区域：
    交通路障用于封锁进入施工区或受损道路，以免车辆不小心通过这些区域。

  • 安装灵活快捷：
    与永久性路障相比，交通路障更加灵活，可以根据需要移动。适用于紧急情况或临时交通管理。

traffic-block-bisa-menurunkan-angka-kece.en:
Safety on the road is our shared responsibility. Every year, thousands of accidents occur due to a lack of clear signs, markings or road dividers. Well, one simple but effective solution to help reduce the number of accidents is use of Traffic Block.

What is Traffic Block?

Traffic Blocks are road dividers which are usually made of high quality plastic and are often filled with water or sand to provide weight. This tool is used to direct, limit or block vehicles from crossing dangerous paths. You may often see it in road construction projects, toll exits, and large parking areas.

How Does Traffic Block Help Reduce Accidents?

  1. Managing Traffic Flow:
    With proper placement, Traffic Blocks help direct vehicles into safe lanes, especially in accident-prone areas such as curves, narrowing roads, or busy intersections.

  2. Provide Clear Visual Warnings:
    Striking colors and attention-grabbing shapes make drivers more alert and careful when crossing areas with barriers.

您是否知道并非所有食品原料都需要存放在冰箱中才能保质很长时间？一个例子是蜂蜜。事实上，将蜂蜜存放在冰箱中会降低其品质。蜂蜜最好在室温下储存在食品安全的密闭容器中，例如 Asia Plastik 的塑料 PET 蜂蜜瓶。

为什么蜂蜜不能放在冰箱里？

将蜂蜜存放在冰箱中会导致结晶或冻结，使质地发生变化且难以使用。事实上，蜂蜜天然含有糖分和高水平的酸度（pH），因此它可以抑制导致腐败的细菌或微生物的生长。换句话说，蜂蜜是一种无需冷藏即可保存很长时间的食品成分。

  • 在室温下保存，最好放在阴凉干燥的地方。

  • 远离阳光直射和热源，例如火炉或烤箱。

  • 确保容器密封，以免水蒸气进入，因为水可以加速蜂蜜发酵。

Not all food ingredients need to be refrigerated, including honey – store them the right way!

Did you know that not all food ingredients need to be stored in the refrigerator so they last a long time? One example is honey. In fact, storing honey in the refrigerator can reduce its quality. Honey is best stored at room temperature in a tightly closed container that is food-safe, such as a plastic PET Honey Bottle from Asia Plastik.

Why Can't Honey Be in the Refrigerator?

Storing honey in the refrigerator can cause crystallization or freezing, making the texture change and difficult to use. In fact, honey naturally contains sugar and a high level of acidity (pH), so it can inhibit the growth of bacteria or microorganisms that cause spoilage. In other words, honey is a food ingredient that can last for a long time without refrigeration.

The Correct Way to Store Honey

To maintain the quality of honey, here are some storage tips:

  • Use the right packaging, such as Plastic Honey Bottles from Asia Plastik, which is safe for food, does not react with the honey content, and keeps the honey hygienic.

  • Store at room temperature, ideally in a cool, dry place.

  • Keep away from direct exposure to sunlight and heat sources such as stoves or ovens.

  • Make sure the container is tightly closed so that no water vapor enters, because water can speed up honey fermentation.

With proper storage and quality containers, you can keep honey fresh, thick and useful for a very long time.

什么是 HDPE？

HDPE 是一种高密度塑料，具有坚固、耐用且使用安全的特点，适用于食品和药品包装。其主要优点是能够承受化学反应，因此不会与液体药物或其他活性成分等包装内容物发生反应。

凭借这些特性，HDPE 成为对包装安全性和稳定性要求较高的行业（尤其是制药行业）的理想选择。

您必须了解的 HDPE 优点

HDPE 具有高度耐腐蚀性化学品的特性，非常适合储存极端 pH 值的物质。这在制药界非常重要，因为必须保持活性物质的稳定性。

5-fakta-seputar-antibiotik-yang-perlu-an.zh:
您需要了解的有关抗生素的 5 个事实

抗生素，也称为抗菌药物，是用于对抗人类和动物细菌引起的感染的药物。抗生素通过杀死细菌或抑制其生长来发挥作用。不过，请务必记住：抗生素不能用于治疗病毒感染，例如流感或感冒。

为了有效、安全地使用抗生素，我们要注意以下五个重要事实：

1.抗生素对病毒感染无效

由于抗生素具有抗菌作用，因此病毒引起的疾病无法用抗生素治疗。由病毒引起的疾病的一些例子包括：

  • 感冒

    • 流感

  • 主要是喉咙痛

  • 主要是咳嗽和支气管炎

  • 一些耳朵和鼻窦感染

针对上述情况服用抗生素不仅无效，还会引发长期的健康问题。

2.过度使用导致抗生素耐药性

不恰当使用抗生素的严重影响之一是抗生素耐药性。当细菌对抗生素产生耐药性时，就会导致感染变得越来越难以治疗。

出现这种情况的原因可能是过于频繁地使用抗生素或未按照建议使用抗生素，例如过早停止服用或使用之前处方中剩余的药物。结果，没有完全死亡的细菌将会存活下来并变得更强大。

3.细菌如何产生耐药性？

细菌可以通过多种方式对抗抗生素。有些会产生酶来中和抗生素，将药物从细胞中泵出，并改变身体结构，使抗生素无法粘附在它们身上。当一种细菌成功生存时，它可以繁殖并将耐药性特征传播给下一代。这就是导致感染更难治疗的原因。

4.并非所有疾病都需要抗生素

当您感到不适时，不要立即服用抗生素。流感或单核细胞增多症等病毒感染不需要抗生素。不小心服用抗生素实际上会让身体在未来更容易受到耐药细菌的感染。

5.如何正确服用抗生素

为了使抗生素有效发挥作用而不引起耐药性，请注意以下事项：

  • 有关抗生素的使用，请务必咨询医生。

  • 确保您知道您所经历的感染是否确实是由细菌引起的。

  • 遵循医生或药剂师的使用说明。

  • 不要保存或使用之前处方中剩余的抗生素。

  • 不要服用他人的抗生素。

  • 即使您感觉好些，也不要跳过剂量。

  • 如果您的医生说您不需要抗生素，请不要要求使用抗生素。

5 Facts About Antibiotics You Need to Know

Antibiotics, also known as antimicrobial drugs, are drugs used to fight infections caused by bacteria, both in humans and animals. Antibiotics work by killing bacteria or inhibiting their growth. However, it is important to remember: antibiotics cannot be used to treat viral infections, such as flu or colds.

In order to use antibiotics effectively and safely, let's pay attention to the following five important facts:

1. Antibiotics Are Not Effective for Viral Infections

Because antibiotics are antibacterial, diseases caused by viruses cannot be treated with antibiotics. Some examples of diseases caused by viruses include:

  • Colds

  • Flu

  • Mostly sore throats

  • Mostly coughs and bronchitis

  • Some ear and sinus infections

Taking antibiotics for the conditions above is not only ineffective, but can also trigger long-term health problems.

2. Excessive Use Causes Antibiotic Resistance

One of the serious impacts of inappropriate use of antibiotics is antibiotic resistance. This is a condition when bacteria become resistant to antibiotics, making infections increasingly difficult to treat.

This can occur due to the use of antibiotics too often or not as recommended, such as stopping consumption prematurely or using leftover medication from a previous prescription. As a result, bacteria that are not completely dead will survive and grow stronger.

3. How Do Bacteria Become Resistant?

Bacteria can fight antibiotics in various ways. Some produce enzymes to neutralize antibiotics, pump drugs out of their cells, and change their body structure so that antibiotics cannot stick to them. When one bacterium manages to survive, it can reproduce and spread the resistant trait to the next generation. This is what makes infections more difficult to treat.

4. Not All Diseases Require Antibiotics

Don't take antibiotics immediately when you feel sick. Viral infections such as flu or mononucleosisdo not require antibiotics. Careless consumption of antibiotics will actually make the body more susceptible to resistant bacteria in the future.

5. How to Take Antibiotics Correctly

In order for antibiotics to work effectively and not cause resistance, pay attention to the following:

  • Always consult a doctor about the use of antibiotics.

  • Make sure you know whether the infection you are experiencing is indeed caused by bacteria.

  • Follow the instructions for use given by your doctor or pharmacist.

  • Do not save or use leftover antibiotics from a previous prescription.

  • Do not take other people's antibiotics.

  • Do not skip doses even if you feel better.

  • Don't ask for antibiotics if your doctor says you don't need them.

  • Lightweight yet sturdy, ideal for pharmaceutical distribution purposes

By choosing the right packaging, such as Hydro Plastic Bottles, you not only maintain the quality of antibiotics, but also support a safer and more efficient drug distribution system.

Conclusion

蚝油一瞥

蚝油是一种神奇的调味品，多年来一直吸引着许多人的味蕾。这种酱汁由焦糖牡蛎提取物和糖制成，通常也称为蚝油。

蚝油在烹饪界如此受欢迎的原因有很多。其独特的口味使其成为亚洲菜肴，尤其是中式和泰式菜肴的中流砥柱。这种酱汁呈现出甜味、咸味和鲜味的结合，诱惑着味蕾。当用于烹饪时，蚝油能够创造出和谐的味道，增强肉类、鸡肉、海鲜和蔬菜等主要食材的味道。

另一个优点是它的灵活性。蚝油可用作炒菜调味料、烤肉的腌料、面食的酱汁以及比萨饼的独特添加物。毫不奇怪，各餐厅的厨师经常依靠它来制作美味且令人难忘的菜肴。

对于餐厅或餐饮等大型厨房需求，蚝油通常包装在大型容器中。一种实用且经济的选择是使用来自 Asia Plastik 的 5 升塑料桶，众所周知，这种塑料桶坚固、食品安全且易于使用。这种包装有助于保持蚝油的质量，同时使其更容易在专业厨房中处理和储存。

嗯，有趣的是，你也可以在家用蚝油制作餐厅风格的菜肴。以下是您可以尝试的五种推荐菜肴：

1.蚝油鸡

蚝油鸡是最受欢迎且易于制作的菜单之一。此菜口味咸甜微辣，适合任何时候享用。

首先用盐和胡椒将鸡块腌制 10–15 分钟。之后，将鸡肉与香料和其他配料一起炒至熟。如需变化，您可以添加姬菇和白菜作为补充，以丰富味道并增加质感。

2.蚝油鱿鱼

鱿鱼是您最喜欢的海鲜之一，与蚝油搭配非常美味。嚼劲十足的口感与蚝油的咸甜味道非常相配。

制作起来非常简单。将鱿鱼清洗干净，然后横切。还要准备胡萝卜、西红柿等蔬菜。炒香料粉，加入蔬菜直至枯萎，然后加入鱿鱼和其他香料，包括蚝油。对于酱汁的稠度，请使用玉米淀粉溶液。趁热与白米饭一起食用。

3. Pakcoy 餐厅风格蚝油

小白菜被誉为新鲜脆脆的蔬菜，非常适合炒菜。与蚝油搭配，味道更加复杂，开胃。

先将蘑菇炒至变色，然后加入切片香料炒香。加一点水，加入白菜和辅助香料。煮至蔬菜完全煮熟并作为健康的配菜。

4.辣椒蚝油虾

虾是一种蛋白质来源，易于准备，非常适合炒菜。添加了蚝油和辣椒粉和腐烂玉米等蔬菜，这道菜已成为家庭菜单上的中流砥柱。

将香料炒香，然后加入半熟的炸虾。添加青椒、玉米和西红柿等蔬菜。这道炒菜配上热米饭非常美味。

5.蚝油鲷鱼

蚝油炸鲷鱼，同时提供鲜美和松脆的口感。这道菜非常适合一家人的晚餐菜单。

将鲷鱼片在面粉中炸至酥脆，然后与切片胡萝卜和葱一起在浓蚝油中烹制。香脆的鱼和美味的酱汁相结合，让这道菜难以忘记。

A Glimpse into Oyster Sauce

Oyster sauce is a magical condiment that has captivated the taste buds of many people for years. Made from caramelized oyster extract with sugar, this sauce is also often called oyster sauce.

There are many reasons why oyster sauce is so popular in the culinary world. Its distinctive taste makes it a mainstay in Asian dishes, especially Chinese and Thai cuisine. This sauce presents a combination of sweet, salty and umami flavors that tempt the taste buds. When used in cooking, oyster sauce is able to create a harmony of flavors that enhances the taste of the main ingredients such as meat, chicken, seafood and vegetables.

Another advantage is its flexibility. Oyster sauce can be used as a stir-fry seasoning, marinade for grilled meat, sauce for pasta, and a unique addition to pizza. It's not surprising that chefs in various restaurants often rely on it to produce delicious and memorable dishes.

For large-scale kitchen needs such as restaurants or catering, oyster sauce is often packaged in large containers. One practical and economical option is to use 5 liter jerry cans from Asia Plastik, which are known to be strong, safe for food, and easy to use. This packaging helps maintain the quality of oyster sauce while making it easier to handle and store in a professional kitchen.

Well, interestingly, you can also make restaurant-style dishes with oyster sauce at home. Here are five recommended dishes that you can try:

1. Oyster Sauce Chicken

Chicken in oyster sauce is one of the most popular menus that is easy to make. This dish has a savory, sweet and slightly spicy taste that is suitable to be enjoyed at any time.

Start by marinating the chicken pieces with salt and pepper for 10–15 minutes. After that, saute the chicken with spices and other ingredients until cooked. For variation, you can add shimeji mushrooms and pak choy as a complement to enrich the taste and add texture.

2. Oyster Sauce Squid

Squid is one of your favorite seafood which is delicious when combined with oyster sauce. The chewy texture pairs very well with the savory and sweet taste of oyster sauce.

It's quite easy to make it. Clean the squid, then slice crosswise. Also prepare vegetables such as carrots and tomatoes. Saute ground spices, add vegetables until wilted, then add squid and other spices including oyster sauce. For sauce thickness, use cornstarch solution. Serve warm with white rice.

3. Pakcoy with Restaurant Style Oyster Sauce

Pakchoy is known as a fresh and crunchy vegetable that is very suitable for stir-fried dishes. When combined with oyster sauce, the taste becomes more complex and appetizing.

Saute the mushrooms first until they change color, then add the sliced spices and saute until fragrant. Add a little water and add the bok choy and complementary spices. Cook until the vegetables are perfectly cooked and serve as a healthy side dish.

4. Paprika Oyster Sauce Shrimp

Shrimp is a source of protein that is easy to prepare and is very suitable for stir-fries. With the addition of oyster sauce and vegetables such as paprika and putren corn, this dish has become a mainstay on the menu at home.

Saute the spices until fragrant, then add the half-cooked fried shrimp. Add vegetables such as bell peppers, corn and tomatoes. This stir-fry is very delicious eaten with warm rice.

5. Snapper in Oyster Sauce

Fried snapper fish covered in oyster sauce provides a savory and crunchy taste at the same time. This dish is very suitable for a dinner menu with the family.

Snapper fillets are fried in flour until crispy, then cooked in thick oyster sauce with sliced carrots and spring onions. The combination of crispy fish and delicious sauce makes this dish hard to forget.

Oyster sauce is not just a complement—it is the main star in many dishes. For household or business kitchen needs, 5 liter jerry cans from Asia Plastik can be an ideal solution. Practical, hygienic and durable!

在商业世界，尤其是农业综合企业领域，包装发挥着不可忽视的重要作用。包装的作用不仅是作为容器，而且是产品的保护和有效的促销工具。一种广泛使用的包装类型是PET（聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯）包装。

PET塑料材料以其各种优点而闻名，特别是在包装肥料等液体产品方面。以下是PET塑料瓶包装的多项优点，使其成为商务人士的主要选择：

1.轻量化环保

与其他类型的塑料（例如 PP 或 HDPE）相比，PET 包装相对较轻。它的重量轻，在配送过程中非常有利，因为它可以降低运输成本。

不仅如此，PET 包装还易于回收。使用过的 PET 瓶可以重新加工成各种产品的回收 PET 包装。因此，PET 包装的使用也支持减少碳排放和保护环境的努力。

2.耐用且坚固

PET 瓶具有良好的强度，可抵抗冲击、压力和其他物理损坏。这使其成为液体肥料等在运输和储存过程中需要额外保护的产品的理想选择。

但是，请注意，标准 PET 包装不耐高温。对于需要热填充（hotfill）的产品，需要使用特殊的 PET 材料，并使用hotfill技术成型。

3.提高吸引力的透明度

PET 包装的主要优点之一是其高透明度。消费者可以直接看到产品的内容，这有助于增强对产品质量和真实性的信心。

产品内容的可视化也是营销中的附加值，因为产品的颜色和纹理会影响购买决策。

4.设计灵活

PET 材料易于成型并可根据需要进行调整。您可以应用各种有趣的形状和设计，例如瓶子、容器或泡罩。

通过正确的设计并添加徽标或品牌标签等视觉元素，PET 包装成为一种有效的促销工具，可以提高市场上的品牌知名度和产品吸引力。

5.耐水和氧气

PET 包装具有良好的防潮和防氧性能。这对于液体肥料等产品尤其重要，因为它可以防止水和空气污染，从而影响产品的有效性和保质期。

PET塑料瓶具有轻质、坚固、透明、柔韧、耐水、耐氧等多种优点，是非常适合农业企业的包装解决方案，尤其是液体肥料产品。

In the business world, especially in the agribusiness sector, packaging plays an important role that cannot be ignored. The function of packaging is not only as a container, but also as product protection and an effective promotional tool. One type of packaging that is widely used is PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate) packaging.

PET plastic material is known for its various advantages, especially in packaging liquid products such as fertilizer. The following are a number of advantages of PET plastic bottle packaging which make it the main choice among business people:

1. Lightweight and Environmentally Friendly

PET packaging is relatively light compared to other types of plastic such as PP or HDPE. Its light weight is very beneficial in the distribution process because it can reduce shipping costs.

Not only that, PET packaging is also easily recycled. PET bottles that have been used can be reprocessed into recycled PET packaging for various products. Thus, the use of PET packaging also supports efforts to reduce carbon emissions and preserve the environment.

2. Durable and Tough

PET bottles have good strength against impact, pressure and other physical damage. This makes it an ideal choice for products such as liquid fertilizer that require extra protection during shipping and storage.

However, please note that standard PET packaging is not resistant to high temperatures. For products that require hot filling (hotfill), a special PET material is required which is molded using hotfill technology.

3. Transparency that Increases Attractiveness

One of the main advantages of PET packaging is its high level of transparency. Consumers can see the contents of the product directly, which helps increase confidence in the quality and authenticity of the product.

Visualization of product contents is also an added value in marketing, because the color and texture of the product can influence purchasing decisions.

4. Flexible in Design

PET material is easy to shape and adjust to needs. You can apply various interesting shapes and designs such as bottles, containers, or blisters.

With the right design and the addition of visual elements such as a logo or brand label, PET packaging becomes an effective promotional tool to increase brand awareness and product attractiveness on the market.

5. Resistant to Water and Oxygen

PET packaging has good resistance to moisture and oxygen. This is especially important for products such as liquid fertilizer, as it prevents contamination from water and air that can affect the effectiveness and shelf life of the product.

With various advantages such as light, strong, transparent, flexible, and water and oxygen resistant, PET plastic bottles are a very suitable packaging solution for agribusinesses — especially for liquid fertilizer products.

simak-cara-rawat-oli-mobil.zh:
车辆中的每个部件都发挥着重要作用，其中最重要的部件之一就是汽车油。汽车油对于维持车辆的性能和使用寿命具有重要作用。因此，了解汽车机油的作用和日常保养对于每个车主来说都很重要。

汽车油的主要功能

一般来说，汽车油具有三大功能。首先，油充当发动机部件的润滑剂。由于存在油，可以最大限度地减少发动机部件之间的摩擦，从而防止损坏并降低发动机性能。如果没有足够的机油，发动机部件将受到直接摩擦并可能导致过热，从而对发动机性能产生负面影响。

其次，油有助于发动机冷却过程。努力工作的发动机会产生热量，而机油可以通过吸收热量并将其分配到发动机的其他部件来帮助减少热量。如果没有油，发动机会更快升温并可能造成损坏。

机油的最终功能是保护发动机免受腐蚀并将污垢输送到机油滤清器。油会覆盖发动机内部并保护其免受氧化和腐蚀。除此之外，机油还有助于将可能污染发动机的小颗粒输送到机油滤清器，从而使发动机保持清洁并发挥最佳功能。

如何保养汽车油

以下是一些汽车机油保养技巧，您可以采取这些技巧来保持发动机性能：

1.确保定期检查油位，至少每月一次或在长途旅行之前。使用油尺检查油位并确保其始终位于最小和最大标记之间。

2.不要让发动机过热。温度过高会降低机油的有效性并损坏发动机。请务必检查冷却系统并将发动机温度保持在安全水平。

3.将汽车油存放在良好的状态。如果您大量购买油，请确保将其存放在干燥的地方，避免阳光直射。正确储存的油将具有更长的保质期和更好的性能。

4.如果您经常在极端条件下驾驶，例如非常热的天气、越野条件或高速行驶，您可能需要更频繁地更换机油。这种情况会降低机油的有效性，还会影响发动机性能。

这就是如何保养汽车油，不要忘记，如果 各位伙伴与朋友们 行业需要汽车油包装，请使用 Asia Plastik 独家提供的 5 升油桶！

Every component in your vehicle has an important role, and one of the vital ones is car oil. Car oil has an important function in maintaining the performance and lifespan of your vehicle. Therefore, understanding the function and routine maintenance of car oil is important for every vehicle owner.

Main Functions of Car Oil

In general, car oil has three main functions. First, oil acts as a lubricant for engine components. With the presence of oil, friction between engine components can be minimized, thereby preventing damage and decreasing engine performance. Without enough oil, engine parts will experience direct friction and can result in overheating which has a negative impact on engine performance.

Secondly, oil helps in the engine cooling process. A hard-working engine will produce heat, and oil can help reduce this heat by absorbing the heat and distributing it to other parts of the engine. Without oil, the engine will heat up more quickly and could potentially cause damage.

The final function of oil is to protect the engine from corrosion and transport dirt to the oil filter. Oil will coat the inside of the engine and protect it from oxidation and corrosion. Apart from that, oil also helps transport small particles that can contaminate the engine to the oil filter, so that the engine remains clean and functions optimally.

How to Care for Your Car Oil

Here are some car oil maintenance tips that you can do to maintain engine performance:

1. Make sure to check the oil level regularly, at least once a month or before traveling long distances. Use an oil dipstick to check the oil level and make sure it is always between the minimum and maximum marks.

2. Don't let the engine overheat. Excessive temperatures can reduce the effectiveness of the oil and damage the engine. Be sure to check the cooling system and keep the engine temperature at a safe level.

3. Store car oil in good condition. If you buy oil in large quantities, make sure to store it in a dry place out of direct sunlight. Oil that is stored properly will have a longer shelf life and better performance.

4. If you often drive in extreme conditions, such as very hot weather, off-road conditions, or driving at high speeds, you may need to change your oil more frequently. This condition can reduce the effectiveness of the oil and also affect engine performance.

<p class="MsoNormal" ><strong><span >Surabaya, 8 Mei 2025</span></strong><span > – Suasana kampus STESIA Surabaya tampak lebih ramai dari biasanya pada hari Kamis (8/5), saat kegiatan <em>Job Fair</em> yang diikuti oleh berbagai perusahaan digelar mulai pukul 08.00 hingga 16.00 WIB. Asia Plastik perusahaan manufaktur plastic, juga tengah aktif mencari sumber daya manusia (SDM) berkualitas untuk bergabung dan tumbuh bersama.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" ><span >本次活动在泗水 STESIA 领导层的热烈欢迎中开始，他们向所有参与的公司表示感谢，并鼓励学生充分利用这次机会。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" ><span >HRD Asia Plastik 负责人 Aris 先生致辞，活动继续进行。他在致辞中呼吁同学们在职业生涯初期不要过于挑剔地选择工作。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" ><span >“不要对工作挑剔。在工作的世界里，我们不仅要与国内的求职者竞争，还要准备好与国外的人力资源竞争。”Aris先生强调。<br />他还鼓励学生们充满信心，持续学习，拥有较高的职业道德，以便在职业领域取得成功。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" ><span >欢迎会结束后，校外的学生和求职者被邀请参观各个招聘租户<em>租户</em>，其中Asia Plastik拥有的租户似乎挤满了求职者。他们中的许多人似乎热衷于直接与 Asia Plastik 的人力资源人员 Devina 交谈。</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" ><span >在谈话中，Devina 表示 Asia Plastik 正在寻找优质人力资源来填补多个职位。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" ><span >“我们正在为管理人员、质量控制 (QC)、研发 (RnD) 和销售/营销人员职位空缺。我们希望从 STESIA 和校外找到最优秀的人才。”</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" ><span >本次招聘会不仅是一次招聘活动，更是学生们更好地了解工作世界、为未来面对职业竞争做好准备的励志时刻。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" ><span >Asia Plastik希望通过这样的活动，公司能够吸引到不仅技术过硬，而且热爱学习、对工作高度忠诚的未来员工。</span></p>

sejarah-dan-rangkuman-hari-pendidikan-na.zh:
5 月 2 日全国教育日：2025 年的历史、意义和纪念

每年5月2日，所有印度尼西亚人民都会纪念全国教育日(Hardiknas)。尽管这不是国定假日，但这一纪念活动仍被广泛庆祝，作为对教育英雄所做贡献的尊重，尤其是Ki Hajar Dewantara。

全国教育日的历史

全国教育日由印度尼西亚政府设立，旨在纪念教育领域的先驱人物、Taman Siswa 机构的创始人 Ki Hajar Dewantara 的贡献。 Ki Hajar Dewantara 出生于 1889 年 5 月 2 日，被誉为勇敢而富有远见的人物，为所有印度尼西亚人民争取受教育权，特别是在荷兰殖民时期。

在殖民时期，教育只有贵族和荷兰公民才能享受。基·哈贾尔·德万塔拉坚决批评这一歧视性政策。由于他尖锐而批判性的写作，他被流放到荷兰。不过，这并没有浇灭他的热情。

返回印度尼西亚后，1922 年 7 月 3 日，他创立了 Taman Siswa，这是一所向所有群体开放的教育机构，无论背景如何。他著名的哲学“Tut Wuri Handayani”（意思是背后给予鼓励）至今已成为国民教育界的座右铭。

为了表彰 Ki Hajar Dewantara 的贡献，印度尼西亚独立后，Ki Hajar Dewantara 被任命为首任教育部长。他于1959年4月26日去世，为了纪念他的功绩，政府通过1959年第316号总统令将他的出生日期定为全国教育日。

2025年全国教育日纪念活动

2024 年，教育、文化、研究和技术部设定了全国教育日主题：
“一起行动，继续自由学习”。

这一主题体现了通过自 2019 年开始运行的自由学习计划继续鼓励教育转型的协作精神。为纪念全国教育日，2024 年 5 月也被指定为 每月自由学习。

今年的全国教育日纪念活动包括将于 2025 年 5 月 2 日 07:30 WIB 同步举行升旗仪式。本次颁奖典礼在线下各机构举行：

  • 中央和地区机构

  • 教育单位（PAUD 到高等教育）

  • 印度尼西亚共和国驻外代表处

逐年国家教育日主题

以下是近年来全国教育日的主题：

  • 2019：加强教育，弘扬文化

  • 2021：同步行动，让学习自由成为现实

  • 2022：引领复苏，走向独立学习

  • 2023：共同庆祝学习自由

    • 结束

    全国教育日不仅仅是一个年度仪式。这是一个反思和提醒人们教育是所有国家儿童的权利的时刻。让我们本着“Tut Wuri Handayani”的精神，继续努力为印度尼西亚的子孙后代建设包容、独立和有意义的教育。
sejarah-dan-rangkuman-hari-pendidikan-na.en:
National Education Day May 2: History, Meaning and Commemoration in 2025

Every May 2, all Indonesian people commemorate National Education Day (Hardiknas). Even though it is not a national holiday, this commemoration is widely celebrated as a form of respect for the services of educational heroes, especially Ki Hajar Dewantara.

History of National Education Day

National Education Day was established by the Indonesian government to commemorate the services of Ki Hajar Dewantara, a pioneering figure in education and founder of the Taman Siswa institution. Born on May 2, 1889, Ki Hajar Dewantara is known as a brave and visionary figure in fighting for the right to education for all Indonesian people, especially during the Dutch colonial period.

During the colonial period, education could only be enjoyed by the nobility and Dutch citizens. Ki Hajar Dewantara firmly criticized this discriminatory policy. As a result of his sharp and critical writing, he was exiled to the Netherlands. However, this did not dampen his enthusiasm.

After returning to Indonesia, on 3 July 1922, he founded Taman Siswa, an educational institution that is open to all groups, regardless of background. His famous philosophy, "Tut Wuri Handayani"—which means behind giving encouragement—has become the motto of the world of national education to this day.

In recognition of his contribution, Ki Hajar Dewantara was appointed as the first Minister of Education after Indonesia's independence. He died on 26 April 1959, and to commemorate his service, the government set the date of his birth as National Education Day throughPresidential Decree No. 316 of 1959.

2025 National Education Day Commemoration

In 2024, The Ministry of Education, Culture, Research and Technology set the National Education Day theme:
"Move Together, Continue Freedom of Learning".

This theme reflects the spirit of collaboration to continue to encourage educational transformation through the Freedom to Learn program, which has been running since 2019. In commemoration of National Education Day, May 2024 is also designated as Month Freedom to Learn.

This year's National Education Day commemoration is filled with simultaneous flag ceremonies on May 2 2025 at 07.30 WIB. This ceremony was held offline at various institutions:

  • Central and regional agencies

  • Education unit (PAUD to tertiary education)

  • Representative offices of the Republic of Indonesia abroad

National Education Day Themes from Year to Year

The following are the themes of National Education Day in recent years:

  • 2019:Strengthening Education, Advancing Culture

  • 2021: Move Simultaneously, Make Freedom of Learning a Reality

  • 2022: Lead the Recovery, Move for Independent Learning

  • 2023: Moving Together to Celebrate Freedom of Learning

Closing

National Education Day is not just an annual ceremony. This is a moment of reflection and reminder that education is the right of all the nation's children. With the spirit of "Tut Wuri Handayani", let's continue the struggle to build inclusive, independent and meaningful education for Indonesia's future generations.

apa-itu-air-mineral.zh:
有时我们对白开水和矿泉水之间的区别感到困惑。其实两者的形式是一样的。每个人的味道似乎也都是一样的。然而，它们实际上有不同吗？那么，矿泉水有什么好处呢？

什么是矿泉水？

矿泉水是含有天然或人造矿物质的水。显然，矿泉水含量与普通水不同。矿泉水取自富含矿物质的地区。这意味着并非所有来源的水都可以被视为矿泉水。矿泉水可能含有大量或少量的矿物质。成分本身有所不同，包括锌、铁, 钙，以及 镁。

矿泉水和普通水有什么区别？

您通常可以从河流和湖泊等大自然或从家里的水龙头获取水。这些水必须煮沸或煮熟才能安全饮用。从口味上来说，白水比矿泉水味道清淡。

白水中含有一个或两个氢原子。即使不含矿物质，白水也可以通过添加营养物质转化为矿泉水。

不过，从品质上来说，矿泉水是更好的营养来源。矿泉水的价格也比可以免费获得的白水贵。

矿泉水要经过一个漫长的过程才最终被包装才能饮用。

矿泉水对健康有哪些好处？

正如之前所解释的，与普通水相比，矿泉水对我们的身体有很多好处，尽管我们必须购买它。以下是一些好处。

1.减肥

白开水或矿泉水可以帮助心情好的人减肥。这是因为水不含脂肪和热量，与苏打水和果汁等通常含有添加糖的其他饮料不同。

水的作用是让你快速饱腹，从而抑制食欲，改善身体的代谢系统消化食物，并有助于减少喝甜食和高热量饮料的欲望。

2.改善骨骼健康

发表在美国临床营养学杂志发现，人体实际上可以从矿泉水中吸收钙，就像乳制品。

除此之外，由于其钙含量，矿泉水可以帮助通过增加骨骼中的矿物质密度来预防骨质疏松症。

3.降低血压

矿泉水含有矿物质镁，它在维持身体的整体状况方面发挥着重要作用。镁有助于调节数百个身体系统，包括血压、血糖以及肌肉和神经功能。

人体需要镁来帮助血管保持放松，从而将压力保持在正常水平。

4.降低低密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平

导致心脏问题的最大因素之一是坏胆固醇又名低密度脂蛋白。

由于矿泉水能够降低低密度脂蛋白胆固醇，经常喝矿泉水的人患心脏病的风险会大大降低。

5.有助于维持健康的消化系统

矿泉水还可以为消化系统带来好处。这要归功于硫酸盐含量，它有助于胰腺释放淀粉酶、蛋白酶和脂肪酶等酶，有助于正确消化食物。

apa-itu-air-mineral.en:
Sometimes we are confused about the difference between plain water and mineral water. In fact, the form of both is the same. The taste of each also seems to be the same. However, are they actually different? So, what are the benefits of mineral water?

What is mineral water?

Mineral water is water that contains minerals, either natural or artificial. Obviously, mineral water content is different from ordinary water. Mineral water is obtained from areas rich in mineral substances. This means that not all water from various sources can be considered mineral water. Mineral water may contain large or small amounts of minerals. The components themselves vary, including zinc (zinc), iron, calcium, and magnesium.

What is the difference between mineral water and plain water?

You can usually get water from nature such as rivers and lakes or from your home tap. This water must be boiled or cooked to make it safe to drink. In terms of taste, plain water has a lighter taste than mineral water.

In white water, there is one hydrogen atom or two hydrogen atoms. Even though it doesn't contain minerals, plain water can still be converted into mineral water by adding nutrients to it.

However, in terms of quality, mineral water is a better source of nutrition. The price of mineral water is also more expensive compared to plain water which can be obtained for free.

Mineral water has to go through a long process before it is finally packaged and you can consume it.

What are the benefits of mineral water for health?

As explained previously, mineral water has many benefits for our bodies compared to ordinary water, even though we have to buy it. Below are some of the benefits.

1. Lose weight

Plain water or mineral water can help those of you who are in the mood lose weight. This is because water does not contain fat and calories, different from other drinks such as soda and juice which usually contain added sugar.

Water works by making you full quickly so that it has the effect of curbing your appetite, improves the body's metabolic system in digesting food, and helps reduce the desire to drink sweet and high-calorie drinks.

2. Improves bone health

a study published on The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition has found that the body can actually absorb calcium from mineral water just like calcium from dairy products.

Apart from that, thanks to its calcium content, mineral water can help prevention of osteoporosis by increasing mineral density in bones.

3. Lowers blood pressure

Mineral water contains the mineral magnesium which plays an important role in maintaining the overall condition of your body. Magnesium helps regulate hundreds of body systems, including blood pressure, blood sugar, and muscle and nerve function.

The human body needs magnesium to help the blood vessels remain relaxed so that this will keep the pressure within normal levels.

4. Reduces LDL

cholesterol levels

One of the biggest factors that makes you have heart problems is bad cholesterol aka LDL.

People who drink mineral water regularly will experience a drastically reduced risk of heart problems due to mineral water's ability to lower LDL cholesterol.

5. Helps maintain a healthy digestive system

Mineral water can also provide benefits for digestive system. This is thanks to the sulfate content which helps the pancreas to release enzymes such as amylase, protoase and lipase which help digest food properly.

  • 添加月桂叶和高良姜。

  • 加入肉和煮水。

  • 加入酱油和盐，搅拌均匀。

    • 3。 牛排

    成分：

    • 500 克牛肉，切块

    • 1 汤匙人造黄油

    • 3 颗大蒜，压碎

    • 1 个洋葱，切片

    • 1 汤匙糖

    • 足够的水

    腌制：

  • 4 汤匙人造黄油

  • 7汤匙甜酱油

  • 5 颗大蒜，切碎

  • 1包原粉

  • 2 个鸡蛋

  • 1/2 茶匙胡椒粉

  • 1/4 茶匙肉豆蔻粉

    • 如何创建：

  • 混合腌料，加入肉，静置 20 分钟。

  • 用人造黄油炒大蒜和洋葱。

  • 加入肉和香料，炒至吸收。

  • 加水和糖，煮至软。


    • 4. 肉罗望子

    成分：

    • 牛羊肉400克，煮切

    • 1 升水

    • 6–10 个红辣椒

    • 2 片月桂叶

    • 2 厘米高良姜，压碎

    • 2汤匙甜酱油

    • 1 汤匙罗望子，用温水冲泡

    • 盐、糖、高汤粉适量

    • 8 个青葱，切片

    • 4 颗大蒜，切片

    • 2 个青辣椒，切片

    • 3 个西红柿，切块

    如何创建：

  • 将洋葱、月桂叶和高良姜炒香。

  • 用新水煮肉，然后炒。

  • 添加罗望子、青辣椒和西红柿。

  • 调味并煮至所有东西都煮熟。


    • 5. 照烧牛肉

    成分：

    • 500 克牛肉，切片

    • 1 个洋葱

    • 5 个青辣椒

    • 1 汤匙人造黄油

    腌制：

    • 3 瓣蒜，切碎

    • 2 厘米姜，细

    • 5汤匙甜酱油

    • 7 汤匙照烧酱

    • 3汤匙酱油

    • 2汤匙芝麻油

    • 胡椒粉适量

    如何创建：

  • 混合腌料，将肉腌30分钟。

  • 用人造黄油炒肉直至煮熟。

  • 加入洋葱和青辣椒，搅拌均匀。


    • 6。 伊祖参巴肉

    • 5 颗大蒜，切碎

  • 添加肉，然后添加其他香料。

    • 2 个胡萝卜，切碎

Every Eid al-Adha, sacrificial meat from animals such as cows, goats or sheep is distributed in raw form. So, we need to process it into delicious food that can be enjoyed with the family.

If usually Eid al-Adha is synonymous with dishes made with coconut milk, this time you can try recipes prepared without coconut milk which are still delicious, healthy and easy to make. Store your kitchen spices neatly and hygienically using Asia Plastic Spice Jars to make cooking more practical!

Here are seven recipes you can try:

1. Soy Sauce Meat

Ingredients:

  • 500 grams of beef or mutton, cut

  • 10 curly red chilies

  • 5 red cayenne peppers

  • 10 red onions

  • 4 garlic

  • 5 tablespoons sweet soy sauce

  • 3 bay leaves

  • 1 galangal segment, crushed

  • Salt to taste

  • Water for boiling

  • Enough oil

How to Create:

  1. Boil the meat until tender, drain.

  2. Clean the chilies and onions, then saute until fragrant.

  3. Add bay leaves and galangal.

  4. Add the meat and cooking water.

  5. Add soy sauce and salt, stir well.

  6. Cook until the water is reduced and absorbed.


2. Black Pepper Beef

Ingredients:

  • 250 grams of beef, thinly sliced and boiled

  • 2 heads of broccoli, chopped and boiled

  • 1/2 head cauliflower, boiled

  • 2 garlic

  • 7 red onions

  • Sugar, salt, ground black pepper to taste

  • Enough oil and water

How to Create:

  1. Crush the onion, then sauté.

  2. Add a little water and add the meat.

  3. Season with sugar, salt and black pepper.

  4. Finally add the broccoli and cauliflower, cook until cooked.


3. Beefsteak

Ingredients:

  • 500 grams of beef, cut

  • 1 tablespoon margarine

  • 3 garlic, crushed

  • 1 onion, sliced

  • 1 tablespoon sugar

  • Enough water

Marination:

  • 4 tablespoons margarine

  • 7 tbsp sweet soy sauce

  • 5 garlic, minced

  • 1 packet stock powder

  • 2 eggs

  • 1/2 tsp ground pepper

  • 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg

How to Create:

  1. Mix the marinade spices, add the meat, let sit for 20 minutes.

  2. Saute garlic and onions in margarine.

  3. Add the meat and spices, stir-fry until absorbed.

  4. Add water and sugar, cook until tender.


4. Meat Tamarind

Ingredients:

  • 400 grams of beef/mutton, boiled and cut

  • 1 liter of water

  • 6–10 red cayenne peppers

  • 2 bay leaves

  • 2 cm galangal, crushed

  • 2 tbsp sweet soy sauce

  • 1 tablespoon tamarind, brewed in warm water

  • Salt, sugar, stock powder to taste

  • 8 shallots, sliced

  • 4 garlic, sliced

  • 2 green chilies, sliced

  • 3 tomatoes, cut

How to Create:

  1. Saute the onions, bay leaves and galangal until fragrant.

  2. Boil the meat in new water, then stir fry.

  3. Add tamarind, green chilies and tomatoes.

  4. Season and cook until everything is cooked.


5. Beef Teriyaki

Ingredients:

  • 500 grams beef, sliced

  • 1 onion

  • 5 green chilies

  • 1 tablespoon margarine

Marination:

  • 3 garlic cloves, finely chopped

  • 2 cm ginger, fine

  • 5 tbsp sweet soy sauce

  • 7 tbsp teriyaki sauce

  • 3 tbsp soy sauce

  • 2 tbsp sesame oil

  • Pepper powder to taste

How to Create:

  1. Mix the marinade spices, marinate the meat for 30 minutes.

  2. Saute the meat in margarine until cooked.

  3. Add onions and green chilies, stir well.


6. Ijo Sambal Meat

Ingredients:

  • 500 grams of beef, sliced

  • 5 garlic, minced

  • Green chilies to taste

  • 1/2 tsp salt

  • 1 tbsp sweet soy sauce

  • 1/4 tsp ground pepper

  • Enough water and oil

How to Create:

  1. Clean the green chilies, set aside.

  2. Saute the garlic and chili.

  3. Add the meat, then add the other spices.

  4. Cook until done.


7. Beef Soup

Ingredients:

  • 250 grams of beef, boiled

  • 50 grams of green beans, cut

  • 2 carrots, chopped

  • 1 potato, cut

  • To taste cabbage, cut

  • 2 pieces of ginger, crushed

  • 2 spring onions, sliced

  • 1 celery, sliced

  • 2 tsp mushroom stock

  • 1 tsp salt

  • 1 tsp ground pepper

  • 3 garlic, fried

  • 1/2 pala

  • 1.5 liters of water

How to Create:

  1. Crush the fried onions and nutmeg, add to the stew.

  2. Add potatoes and carrots, cook for 10 minutes.

  3. Add the beans, cabbage, spring onions and celery.

  4. Season, cook until done.

tips-memilih-oli-sepeda-motor.zh:
油，又名润滑剂，对于摩托车具有重要意义。它有助于帮助发动机实现最佳性能，并且不会产生直接摩擦。当然，在选择润滑油时也不能马虎，一定要适合自己车辆的发动机类型。润滑剂就像发动机的主进气口。如果没有足够的发动机机油，发动机润滑将达不到最佳效果。发动机中的重要部件，例如气缸、缸体和活塞环，会更快地磨损并被划伤。如何选择合适的机油？

嗯，通常官方制造商车间或值得信赖的车间的机械师会推荐适合他所处理的车辆的机油类型。 “通常修理店的工作人员会为您的汽车提供优质的机油。但是，您还必须知道哪种机油适合您的车辆，”PT Suzuki Indomobil Motor (SIM) 备件部门负责人 Christiana Yuwantie 说道。

<旁白>

购买之前您需要了解几件事。从粘度级别 (SAE)、质量代码 (API) 到类型。以下是确定适合您摩托车的机油的简单技巧。

1。阅读车辆手册

选择合适机油的最简单方法是阅读车辆手册。手册中解释了发动机规格和正确的机油类型。 “选择合适机油的最简单方法是阅读汽车手册。另一个重要的事情是与发动机的兼容性和质量，而不仅仅是品牌，”他说。

2。检查油粘度

每种发动机油都有相同的功能。然而，如果润滑剂的含量与车辆发动机的特性不匹配，则润滑剂将无法发挥最佳作用。 “通常可以从液体的粘度看出油的差异。粘度的水平，又名粘度等级，由汽车工程师协会 (SAE) 编号表示。油越稀，对汽车发动机越好，”他说。

是的，注意油品包装，通常有代码SAE 10W-30、SAE 20W-40、SAE 20W-50等，这是什么意思？ SAE 是汽车工程师协会标准的缩写。供您参考，SAE 是一个国际机构，其粘度指数也在世界各地使用。

字母 SAE 后面的数字描述了油在低温下的粘度。那么字母W后面或最后的数字就是发动机处于工作状态或热时的粘度水平。数字越大，该条件下的油越稠。反之亦然，数字越小，油越稀。

除了SAE之外，机油包装上还有API代码。 API是美国石油协会或国外使用的油品质量检验机构的缩写。该 API 代码通常后跟其他字母，例如 API SL、API SN、API SP 等。字母 S 后面的字母越高，油的质量越好，并且符合最新标准。

3。制油原料

车用油分为两类材质，即合成油和矿物油。合成油是由具有添加剂特性的各种化学品制成的，而矿物油是从石油提取中形成的。哪种油比较好？

各有优点和缺点。最简单的选择方法是摩托车的年龄。如果您的摩托车还很年轻，那么就使用合成油。好的油是来自石油的矿物油。这意味着这种油比与其他化学品混合的合成油更天然。

4。提防假油

目前，市场上流传着很多假油的情况。石油销售商通常会设定比标准价格更低的价格。 “其实假油的迹象很容易识别，从价格上就可以看出来，润滑油的颜色较深，略带腐臭和粗糙的气味，就像含有金属一样。”克里斯蒂娜说。

这就是关于选择摩托车油的技巧的完整讨论。但如果 各位伙伴与朋友们 行业需要机油包装，各位伙伴与朋友们 可以使用 Asia Plastik 的 900 毫升油瓶！

tips-memilih-oli-sepeda-motor.en:
Oil, aka lubricant, has an important meaning for motorbikes. It plays a role in helping the engine perform optimally and not experience direct friction. Of course, when choosing a lubricant, you should not be careless, it must be suitable for your vehicle's engine type. Lubricant is like the main intake for an engine. If there is not enough engine oil, engine lubrication will be less than optimal. Important components in the engine such as the cylinder, block and piston rings wear out and become scratched more quickly. How to choose the right oil?

Well, usually a mechanic at an official manufacturer's workshop or a trusted workshop will recommend the type of oil that is suitable for the vehicle he is handling. "Usually the repair shop staff will offer good oil for your car. However, you also have to know what kind of oil is right for your vehicle," said Spare Parts Department Head of PT Suzuki Indomobil Motor (SIM) Christiana Yuwantie.

There are several things you need to know before making a purchase. Starting from the viscosity level (SAE), quality code (API), to the type. Here are easy tips for determining the right oil for your motorbike.

1. Reading the Vehicle Manual Book

The easiest way to choose the right oil is to read the vehicle manual. In the manual, the engine specifications and the correct type of oil are explained. "The simplest way to choose the right oil is to read your car's manual. Another important thing is compatibility with the engine and quality, not just the brand," he said.

2. Check Oil Viscosity

Each engine oil has the same function. However, lubricants will not work optimally if their contents do not match the characteristics of the vehicle's engine. "Usually the difference in oil can be seen from the viscosity of the liquid. The level of viscosity, aka viscosity-grade, is indicated by the Society of Automotive Engineer (SAE) number. The thinner the oil, the better it is for the car engine," he said.

Yep, pay attention to the oil packaging, usually there are codes SAE 10W-30, SAE 20W-40, SAE 20W-50, etc. What does it mean? SAE is an abbreviation for Society of Automotive Engineers Standards. For your information, SAE is an international body whose viscosity index is also used in various parts of the world.

The number after the letters SAE describes the viscosity of the oil at cold temperatures. Then the number after the letter W or the last is the viscosity level when the engine is in working condition or is hot. The bigger the number, the thicker the oil is in that condition. Vice versa, the smaller the number, the thinner the oil.

Apart from SAE, there is also an API code on motor oil packaging. The abbreviation for API is the American Petroleum Institute or oil quality inspection agency used abroad. This API code is usually followed by other letters, such as API SL, API SN, API SP, and others. The higher the letter following the letter S, the better the quality of the oil and that it meets the latest standards.

3. Ingredients for Making Oil

Vehicle oil is divided into two types of materials, namely synthetic and mineral oil. Synthetic oil is made from various chemicals with additive properties, while mineral oil is formed from petroleum extraction. Which oil is better?

Each has advantages and disadvantages. The easiest way to choose is the age of the motorbike. If your motorbike is young, then just use synthetic oil. Good oil is mineral oil which comes from petroleum. This means that this oil is more natural than synthetic oil that has been mixed with other chemicals.

4. Watch Out for Fake Oil

Currently, there is a lot circulating on the market about fake oil. Oil sellers will usually set a lower price compared to the standard price. "Actually, it's easy to recognize the signs of fake oil, you can see it from the price, the darker color of the lubricant, the slightly rancid and rough smell, like it contains metal," said Christiana.

cuci-tangan-dengan-sabun-khusus-atau-sab.zh:
根据一项研究，平均每个人每小时触摸脸部 16-23 次。事实上，手掌上的细菌、病毒或病菌可以在不知不觉中进入眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴。你能想象如果用脏手摸脸会有什么风险吗？

因此，每天保持双手清洁，可以避免各种疾病。总之，洗手是一种简单而有效的防病方法。问题是，洗手用专用肥皂和沐浴露哪个更好？

抗菌能有效杀死细菌，你确定吗？

仍然有很多人低估了洗手的好处。事实上，这个“小”习惯可以保护我们免受多种疾病的侵害。其中包括流感、感冒、伤寒、甲型肝炎、喉咙痛、细菌感染大肠杆菌，甚至是目前席卷全球的COVID-19。嘿，你确定你还懒得洗手吗？

回到主标题，洗手用专用肥皂和沐浴露哪个更好？ 

事实上，根据明尼苏达州卫生部的专家的说法，抗菌肥皂等特殊肥皂在杀死致病细菌方面并不比普通肥皂（包括不含抗菌成分的沐浴皂）和水更有效。 

没有证据表明抗菌肥皂比沐浴露等普通肥皂更能有效预防家庭或公共场所的感染。

因此，在家里或公共场所，普通肥皂就足以保持双手清洁。不过，对于卫生工作者或医院的医生来说，出于医学原因，仍然建议使用抗菌肥皂。

美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 也提出了类似的论点。美国食品和药物管理局表示，没有足够的证据表明非处方抗菌肥皂比普通肥皂和水更能预防疾病。长话短说，到目前为止，使用抗菌洗手液的好处尚未得到证实。

何时以及如何？ 

了解洗手是防止细菌传播的最有效方法。请记住，干净的双手可以阻止细菌从一个人传播到另一个人，以及在整个社区（从家庭到工作场所）传播。

那么，什么时候是洗手的最佳时间？据美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）的专家称，以下情况应洗手：

  • 准备食物之前、期间和之后。
  • 进食前。
  • 在家中照顾呕吐或腹泻患者之前和之后。
  • 处理伤口之前和之后。
  • 如厕后。
  • 为上完厕所的孩子更换尿布或清洁身体后。
  • 擤鼻涕、咳嗽或打喷嚏后。
  • 接触动物、动物饲料或动物粪便后。
  • 给予宠物食品或宠物零食后。
  • 触摸垃圾桶后。

接下来，如何正确洗手？您可以采取五个简单的步骤，即：

  1. 弄湿它。 用干净的自来水（温水或冷水）弄湿双手，关闭水龙头，然后使用肥皂。
  2. 泡沫。 用肥皂揉搓双手直至起泡。在手掌、手背、手指之间和指甲下揉搓出泡沫。 
  3. 摩擦。 搓手至少20秒。需要计时器吗？将歌曲“生日快乐”从头到尾唱两遍。
  4. 冲洗。 然后，用干净的自来水正确冲洗双手。
  5. 干燥。 最后，用干净的毛巾擦干双手。

cuci-tangan-dengan-sabun-khusus-atau-sab.en:
According to a study, the average person touches their face 16-23 times every hour. In fact, bacteria, viruses or germs on the palms of the hands can enter the eyes, nose, mouth, without realizing it. Can you imagine what the risks are if you touch your face with dirty hands?

Therefore, keep your hands clean every day to avoid various diseases. In short, washing your hands is a simple and effective way to get sick. The question is, which one is better to wash your hands with special soap or bath soap?

Antibacterial is effective in killing bacteria, are you sure?

There are still many people who underestimate the benefits of washing their hands. In fact, this 'small' habit can protect us from a number of diseases. These include flu, colds, typhoid, hepatitis A, sore throats, bacterial infections E.coli, and even COVID-19 which is currently sweeping the world. Hey, are you sure you're still too lazy to wash your hands?

Back to the main headline, which is better between washing your hands with special soap or bath soap? 

In fact, according to experts at the Minnesota Department of Health, sspecial soaps such as antibacterial soap are no more effective than regular soap (including bath soap without antibacterial content) and water, in killing disease-causing germs. 

There is no evidence that antibacterial soap is more effective than regular soap such as body wash, for preventing infections at home or in public places.

Therefore, ordinary soap is sufficient to keep hands clean at home or in public places. However, for health workers or doctors in hospitals, antibacterial soap is still recommended for medical reasons.

A similar argument also came from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). According to the US Food and Drug Administration, there is not enough evidence to show that over-the-counter antibacterial soap is better at preventing disease than regular soap and water. Long story short, until now the benefits of using antibacterial hand soap have not been proven.

When and How? 

Understand that washing your hands is the most effective way to prevent the spread of germs. Remember, clean hands can stop the spread of germs from one person to another, and throughout the community (from home to work).

So, when is the best time to wash your hands? According to experts at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) washing hands should be done when:

  • Before, during, and after preparing food.
  • Before eating.
  • Before and after caring for someone at home who is sick with vomiting or diarrhea.
  • Before and after treating wounds.
  • After using the toilet.
  • After changing a diaper or cleaning the body of a child who has used the toilet.
  • Setelah membuang ingus, batuk, atau bersin.
  • Setelah menyentuh hewan, pakan ternak, atau kotoran hewan.
  • Setelah memberi makanan hewan, atau camilan hewan peliharaan.
  • Setelah menyentuh sampah.

Selanjutnya, bagaimana cara mencuci tangan yang benar? Ada lima langkah sederhana yang bisa dilakukan, yaitu: 

  1. Basahi. Basahi tangan dengan air bersih yang mengalir (hangat atau dingin), matikan keran, dan gunakan sabun.
  2. Busa. Gosok tangan kedua tangan menggunakan sabun hingga berbusa. Gosok sampai berbusa bagian telapak tangan, punggung tangan, di sela-sela jari, dan di bawah kuku. 
  3. Gosok. Gosoklah tangan setidaknya selama 20 detik. Butuh pengatur waktu? Nyanyikan lagu "Happy Birthday" dari awal sampai akhir sebanyak dua kali.
  4. Bilas. Lalu, bilas tangan dengan benar di bawah air bersih yang mengalir.
  5. Keringkan. Terakhir, keringkan tangan menggunakan handuk bersih.

开斋节快到了。对于那些工作的人来说，当然是时候从日常工作中休息一下，享受一个短暂的假期了。您肯定不想浪费开斋节假期这次吗？

原因是，开斋节假期是许多人期待放松身心、与家人团聚、与亲人一起享受开斋节时光的时刻。那么如何充分利用开斋节假期呢？来来来，我们来看看以下几点！

1。与家人一起计划假期或活动

旅行储蓄图示（freepik.com/pixel-shot.com）

充分利用开斋节假期的最佳方式之一是计划一次旅行或有趣的家庭活动。尝试去旅游景点度假，与家人一起在公园野餐，或者做一项全家人都喜欢的活动。

仔细计划您的假期日程，以充分利用它。另外，请确保所有家庭成员都参与到计划过程中。

2。利用空闲时间进行礼拜

禁食月崇拜插图 (pexels.com/Alena Darmel)

开斋节之前的假期也可以用来增加崇拜。利用空闲时间与家人一起在清真寺祈祷、阅读《古兰经》或做礼拜和祈祷。

利用斋月期间平静和幸福的气氛来接近真主SWT。此外，斋月的最后几晚是加强崇拜的最佳时机。

3。与他人分享

分享善意的插图（freepik.com/freepik）

伊斯兰教中重要的礼拜行为之一是与他人分享，尤其是在斋月期间。趁着开斋节假期，与有需要的人分享快乐。

您可以参观医院或孤儿院，向有需要的人捐款，或开展其他社交活动。重点是你正在努力帮助那些不幸的人。

4。与家人共度美好时光

与孩子一起玩耍的插图 (pexels.com/Andrea皮亚夸迪奥）

开斋节前的假期是与家人共度美好时光的最佳时机。利用这段空闲时间与亲人聚会、聊天并分享故事。

你们还可以一起吃饭，玩家庭游戏，或者只是坐在一起享受在一起的时光。请记住，这样的时刻是生命中最有价值的时刻。

5。休息并恢复精神

充足睡眠插画（freepik.com/gpointstudio）

最后但并非最不重要的一点是，利用开斋节假期休息和恢复活力。不要让假期溜走而没有自己的时间。

进行让您放松和快乐的活动，例如充足的睡眠、读书或观看您最喜欢的电影。充分休息可以恢复精力，以便在假期结束后准备好面对日常生活。

开斋节前的假期是一个黄金机会，需要以多种方式加以利用。事实上，您有很多机会让这个开斋节假期成为一个愉快而有价值的时刻。祝您的开斋节假期充满幸福、平安和丰盛的祝福，OK！

7-cara-kembali-semangat-bekerja-setelah-.en:
After enjoying a long holiday during Eid, now is the time to return to your work routine. However, it is often difficult for some people to restore enthusiasm for work after a pleasant holiday. Boredom and laziness are the main obstacles in returning to activities at work.

To revive your enthusiasm for work after the holiday Eid, it is important to give yourself time to adapt again.

Make room to restructure your work schedule and create a to-do list to make it easier to get back into a routine.

Apart from that, don't forget to give yourself rewards after completing the specified tasks.

There are various other methods that you can use to get excited about returning to work after the Eid holiday, to find out more, you can read this article.

How to Re-energize Work after the Eid Holidays

1. Setting New Work Goals and Targets

Setelah liburan Lebaran, penting untuk menetapkan tujuan dan target kerja baru agar dapat memotivasi diri sendiri. Dengan memiliki tujuan yang jelas, kita akan lebih fokus dan semangat untuk bekerja.

Buatlah rencana kerja yang terstruktur dan realistis untuk mencapai hasil yang diinginkan.

2. Berkomunikasi dengan Rekan Kerja

Berbicara dengan rekan kerja tentang liburan Lebaran dapat membantu dalam membangun kembali semangat bekerja.

Dengan berbagi cerita dan pengalaman liburan, kita bisa merasa lebih terhubung dan termotivasi. Diskusikan juga ide-ide baru untuk meningkatkan produktivitas di tempat kerja.

3. Istirahat yang Cukup dan Pola Makan Sehat

Setelah liburan yang melelahkan, penting untuk memberikan tubuh istirahat yang cukup agar dapat kembali segar dan bugar. Jaga pola makan yang sehat dengan mengonsumsi makanan bergizi agar energi kita tetap terjaga dan semangat bekerja meningkat.

 

4. Berolahraga dan Menyegarkan Pikiran

Berolahraga secara teratur dapat membantu dalam meredakan stres dan meningkatkan energi. Dengan memiliki pikiran yang segar, kita akan lebih siap untuk kembali bekerja dengan semangat yang baru.

5. Mengatur Waktu dan Prioritas dengan Baik

Mengatur waktu dengan baik dan menetapkan prioritas kerja yang jelas akan membantu dalam mengembalikan semangat bekerja setelah liburan Lebaran.

Buatlah jadwal kerja yang terstruktur dan sesuaikan dengan kebutuhan pekerjaan.

 

6. Menetapkan Reward untuk Diri Sendiri

Memberikan reward atau penghargaan dalam bentuk apa pun setelah mencapai target kerja dapat menjadi motivasi tambahan. Jangan lupakan untuk memberikan apresiasi kepada diri sendiri atas usaha dan pencapaian yang telah dilakukan.

7. Tetap Positif dan Bersyukur

Terakhir, tetaplah berpikir positif dan bersyukur atas kesempatan untuk kembali bekerja setelah liburan Lebaran. Sikap positif akan membantu menjaga semangat dan motivasi dalam menjalani aktivitas sehari-hari di tempat kerja.

了解沐浴皂的类型，以免做出错误的选择

就像面部护理一样，身体护理也需要根据每个皮肤的需求进行调整。基本步骤之一是选择合适的沐浴皂。在市场上，您会发现各种类型的沐浴皂，从沐浴露到香皂。每个都有自己的特点和优势。来吧，深入了解一下，以免选择时迷茫！

1. 沐浴露

沐浴露是最常用的液体肥皂类型之一。它的功能保持不变，即清洁皮肤上的污垢、油脂、汗水和引起难闻气味的细菌。沐浴露的特别之处在于其中的保湿成分。这种肥皂通常采用温和成分配制，适合敏感肌肤，因为它能够更长时间地保持皮肤水分。

一些沐浴露产品现在还配备了天然成分，例如来自蜜蜂的蜂胶。此内容不仅能保持水分，还能帮助皮肤再生，使皮肤看起来更健康、更明亮。

2. 沐浴露

乍一看与沐浴露类似，但沐浴露质地较浓稠。沐浴露的香气通常更浓郁、更持久，对于喜欢沐浴时清新气味的人来说是一个有吸引力的选择。但其保湿力往往低于沐浴露，因此更适合中性或油性皮肤。

3. 香皂（香皂）

肥皂是最经典、最常见的肥皂类型。优点是实用，节省空间。然而，条皂的 pH 值往往较高，因此会使皮肤感觉干燥，尤其是如果使用过于频繁的话。为了克服这个问题，请选择含有保湿剂或具有平衡 pH 值的香皂。您还需要注意清洁，因为条皂没有存放在密闭容器中，因此更容易被污垢或细菌污染。

4. 泡沫洗涤

对于沐浴时泡沫丰富的人来说，泡沫洗液或沐浴露可能是最好的选择。这款肥皂呈柔软泡沫形式，可立即使用，接触皮肤时提供奢华的感觉。然而，它的使用可能会更加浪费，因为它的质地较轻，每次使用时需要更多的产品。

5. 沐浴粉

这种类型的肥皂仍然相对较新，市场上并不常见。沐浴露呈粉末状，通常含有对皮肤安全的天然成分。由于它是粉末形式，这种肥皂通常采用小袋包装，以保持产品新鲜度并防止空气或水分污染。

Know the Types of Bath Soap so You Don't Make the Wrong Choice

Just like facial care, body care also needs to be adjusted to each skin's needs. One of the basic steps is choosing the right bath soap. On the market, you will find various types of bath soap, from body wash to bar soap. Each has its own characteristics and advantages. Come on, get to know more deeply so you don't get confused when choosing!

1. Body Wash

Body wash is one of the most commonly used types of liquid soap. Its function remains the same, namely cleaning the skin from dirt, oil, sweat and bacteria that cause unpleasant odors. What makes body wash special is the moisturizing content in it. This soap is usually formulated with gentle ingredients and is suitable for sensitive skin because it is able to maintain skin moisture for longer.

Some body wash products are now also equipped with natural ingredients, such aspropolis from honey bees. This content not only maintains moisture, but also helps skin regeneration and makes skin look healthier and brighter.

2. Shower Gel

At first glance it is similar to body wash, but shower gel has a thicker texture. The aroma of shower gel is usually sharper and longer lasting, making it an attractive choice for lovers of fresh smells when bathing. However, its moisturizing power tends to be lower than body wash, so it is more suitable for normal or oily skin.

3. Bar Soap (Bar Soap)

Bar soap is the most classic and commonly found type of soap. The advantage is that it is practical and saves space. However, bar soap tends to have a higher pH so it can make the skin feel dry, especially if used too often. To overcome this, choose bar soap that contains moisturizer or has a balanced pH. You also need to pay attention to cleanliness because bar soap is more easily contaminated with dirt or bacteria because it is not stored in a closed container.

4. Foaming Wash

Bagi penggemar busa melimpah saat mandi, foaming wash atau body mousse bisa jadi pilihan favorit. Sabun ini hadir dalam bentuk busa lembut yang langsung siap pakai, memberikan sensasi mewah saat menyentuh kulit. Hanya saja, penggunaannya bisa lebih boros karena teksturnya yang ringan membutuhkan jumlah produk lebih banyak setiap kali pemakaian.

5. Body Wash Powder

Jenis sabun yang satu ini masih tergolong baru dan belum banyak ditemukan di pasaran. Body wash powder hadir dalam bentuk bubuk dan biasanya mengandung bahan-bahan alami yang aman untuk kulit. Karena bentuknya bubuk, sabun ini umumnya dikemas dalam sachet kecil untuk menjaga kesegaran produk dan mencegah kontaminasi udara atau kelembapan.

Setelah mengetahui kelebihan dan kekurangan masing-masing jenis sabun mandi, kini saatnya Anda menentukan pilihan sesuai kebutuhan kulit Anda. 谁说假期就一定很贵？印度尼西亚是一个充满魅力的国家，拥有许多令人兴奋的旅游景点，无需花费太多即可享受。

想象一下，您可以与您所爱的人一起探索这些神奇的地方，而不必考虑沉重的经济负担。

因此，无需再犹豫将这些旅游景点列入您的假期清单。从异国情调的海滩到美丽的绿色山丘，一切不仅提供令人兴奋的感觉，而且还方便携带！

对于那些喜欢在不花太多钱的情况下享受乐趣的人，这里总结了印度尼西亚 10 个低预算旅游景点：

<强>1。拉努·昆博洛

Ranu Kumbolo 位于 Lumajang Regency，听起来真的像是登山者的天堂！位于这个高度的湖泊绝对能提供非凡的体验。

清澈碧蓝的海水，周围群山和森林，真是一种令人惊叹的氛围，想要尝试在这里旅行的感觉，只需准备大约20万至30万印尼盾的预算。

<强>2。安耶

位于西冷 (Serang) 的安亚海滩 (Anyer Beach) 不仅可以欣赏到令人惊叹的海景，还可以享受各种活动和游乐设施。

从冲浪、潜水，到享受全地形车和香蕉船的乐趣。安亚海滩的入场费约为 10,000 印尼盾至 250,000 印尼盾

<强>3。 Kyai Langgeng公园

中爪哇省的凯朗庚公园拥有迷人的自然美景，包括苏宾山的景色、清澈的普罗戈河、山坡上大片的稻田以及数百棵珍稀树木。门票价格为每人 30,000 印尼盾（周末），每人 24,000 印尼盾（工作日），网上经常有促销活动每人 15,000 印尼盾。

<强>4。布特拉达玛住宿

推荐 Putra Darma Inn 作为日惹 Gunung Kidul 经济实惠且舒适的住宿选择。该酒店的价格非常实惠，特别是双人间房型，每晚仅需 257,819 印尼盾。

<强>5。寂静湖

顾名思义，这个位于普禾加多的旅游胜地仍然没有拥挤的游客，营造出理想的宁静氛围。

这个湖的水是如此清澈和新鲜，为任何决定游泳的人提供清爽的感觉。价格还是实惠的，每人只需15,000印尼盾。

<强>6。水吹努沙杜瓦

水吹努沙杜瓦 (Water Blow Nusa Dua) 可以欣赏到巨浪冲击海滩上大岩石的全景。地点位于巴厘岛旅游发展公司 (BTDC) 区域，就在巴厘岛君悦酒店后面。

要到达 Water Blow 的最佳拍照地点，游客需要支付 10,000 印尼盾至 25,000 印尼盾。

7.蓝湖

这个湖位于 Gunung Gede Pangrango 国家公园内，其独特之处在于水的颜色会发生变化，包括蓝色、棕色和绿色。

该湖海拔1,115米，气候凉爽。门票价格相当实惠，每人仅需10,000印尼盾。

<强>9。 TNGGP Canopy Trail，Cibodas

Gunung Gede Pangrango 国家公园、Cibodas、Cianjur 的树冠步道对于喜欢刺激挑战的爱好者来说是一个有趣的旅游选择。

游客可以欣赏一座130米长的吊桥，距地面高度45米，吊桥与四棵树相连。门票相当实惠，每人31,000印尼盾左右。

10。彭加隆竹屋

如果您正在寻找一个适合在 Instagram 上发布的度假胜地，位于巴厘岛卡朗阿森 Antiga 村的 Pengalon 竹屋可能是理想的选择。

这座宏伟的竹子建筑最初是用于节日，但其建筑魅力吸引了许多游客。

游客无需支付入场费即可欣赏美景，使其成为一个有趣的地方，并可以自由地在社交媒体上永垂不朽。

那么，你决定去哪里度假？

10-tempat-wisata-low-budget-di-indonesia.en:
Who says holidays have to be expensive? Indonesia, a country rich in charm, has many exciting tourist attractions that can be enjoyed without hurting your wallet.

Imagine, you can explore these amazing places with your loved ones without having to think about heavy financial burdens.

So, there's no need to hesitate any longer to include these tourist attractions on your holiday list.Starting from exotic beaches to beautiful green hills, everything not only provides an exciting sensation, but is also pocket-friendly!

For those who like to have fun without breaking the bank, here is a summary of 10 low budget tourist attractions in Indonesia:

1. Ranu Kumbolo

Ranu Kumbolo, which is located in Lumajang Regency, really sounds like a climber's paradise! The lake which is located at this height definitely provides an extraordinary experience.

The view of clear blue water, surrounded by mountains and forests, really provides an amazing atmosphere, to try the sensation of traveling here you only need to prepare a budget of around IDR 200,000 to IDR 300,000.

2. Anyer

Anyer Beach, located in Serang, not only offers stunning sea panoramas, but also various activities and rides that can be enjoyed.

Starting from surfing, diving, to having fun with ATVs and banana boats. The entrance fee to Anyer Beach is around IDR 10,000 to IDR 250,000

3. Kyai Langgeng Park

Kai Langgeng Park in Central Java offers enchanting natural beauty, including views of Mount Sumbing, the clear Progo River, expanses of rice fields on the mountain slopes, and hundreds of rare trees. The entrance ticket price is IDR 30,000 per person (weekends), IDR 24,000 per person (weekdays), and there are often online promotions at IDR 15,000 per person.

4. Putra Darma Accommodation

Recommended Putra Darma Inn as an affordable and comfortable accommodation option in Gunung Kidul, Yogyakarta. This accommodation offers very affordable rates, especially for the Double Room room type, at only IDR 257,819 per night.

5. Silent Lake

As the name suggests, this tourist destination located in Purwokerto is still devoid of crowds of visitors, creating an ideal atmosphere for tranquility.

The water in this lake is so clear and fresh, providing refreshment for anyone who decides to swim.The price is still affordable, only IDR 15,000 per person.

6. Water Blow Nusa Dua

Water Blow Nusa Dua offers a panoramic view of high waves hitting large rocks on the beach. The location is in the Bali Tourism Development Corporation (BTDC) area, right behind the Grand Hyatt Bali Hotel.

To reach the best photo location at Water Blow, visitors need to pay IDR 10,000 to IDR 25,000.

7. Blue Lake

This lake is located in the Gunung Gede Pangrango National Park and is unique in that the color of the water can change, including blue, brown and green.

Located at an altitude of 1,115 meters above sea level, this lake provides a cool, refreshing atmosphere. The entrance ticket price is quite affordable, only IDR 10,000 per person.

8. Jayanti Beach

Jayanti Beach, located in Cidamar Village, Cidaun District, Cianjur Regency, is a beach destination that still maintains its naturalness and authenticity.

This beach has not been touched by the tourism industry or other industries, so its beauty remains optimal. When visiting this tourist spot, visitors only need to pay an entrance ticket of IDR 5,000 per person.

9. TNGGP Canopy Trail, Cibodas

Canopy trail in Gunung Gede Pangrango National Park, Cibodas, Cianjur, is an interesting tourist choice for fans of adrenaline challenges.

Visitors can enjoy a 130 meter suspension bridge with a height of 45 meters above the ground, which is connected to four trees. The entrance ticket is quite affordable, around IDR 31,000 per person.

10. Pengalon Bamboo House

If you are looking for an Instagrammable holiday destination, the Pengalon Bamboo House in Antiga Village, Karangasem, Bali could be the ideal choice.

This magnificent building made of bamboo was originally used for a festival, but its architectural appeal has attracted many tourists.

Visitors can enjoy the beauty without being charged an entrance fee, making it an interesting place and free to immortalize on social media.

So, where have you decided to go on holiday?
