与男士洗面奶相比，女士洗面奶更常见，也更容易找到。还有更多女性洗面皂产品。因此，大多数男性在洗脸时经常使用女性洗面奶。不过，男士洗面奶和女士洗面奶有区别吗？

男性和女性面部皮肤差异

 
 
 
《国际女性皮肤病学杂志》（2018 年）中的一项科学研究着眼于男性和女性面部皮肤的差异。 

这项研究对 1,070 篇文献进行了科学审查。研究结果表明，男性和女性的面部皮肤往往存在差异。

平均而言，男性的皮肤比女性更油腻。 

这是由于身高高于男性的皮肤中层（真皮）中的胶原蛋白（一种蛋白质）含量所致女性。

 

区分两者皮肤的另一件事是男性剃除面部毛发（包括胡须和胡须）的习惯。

男人需要做定期去角质以减缓面部毛发的生长。

由于皮肤状况和习惯存在这些差异，男士的面部护理方法以及使用的护肤品，包括洗面皂，也应该与女士不同。

男士和女士洗面奶的差异

男士洗面奶与女士洗面奶有一些不同之处。不过，大部分内容还是一样的。

以下是男女通用洁面皂成分的一些差异。

1.含有去角质剂

男士洗面奶除了清洁之外，还可以去角质。两者都有重要的目标：保持皮肤健康，容光焕发。

一款男士洁面皂产品中含有去角质剂和清洁剂。这是为了让那些倾向于跳过 double 的男士更轻松地完成护肤步骤清洁。

洁面皂中的去角质成分旨在去除面部皮肤上的死皮细胞、灰尘、污垢和多余油脂。

此外，去角质成分有助于减缓胡须和胡须等面部毛发的生长。

2.含有防腐剂或抗菌剂

男士洗面奶一般还含有抗菌成分，例如过氧化苯甲酰或苯甲酰过氧化物。

 

过氧化苯甲酰是一种用于治疗痤疮的成分

这种活性成分可作为防腐剂，减少皮肤表面的病菌和细菌数量。

男性面部皮肤出油较多，容易粘附灰尘和污垢。

这种情况会滋生导致面部痤疮快速生长的细菌。

因此，男士洗面奶不仅可以清洁面部，还可以帮助祛痘和护理油性皮肤类型。

3.含有芦荟凝胶

芦荟凝胶可用于洁面皂或其他女性面部护理产品中。

但是，男士洁面皂产品中含有芦荟凝胶。

芦荟凝胶有助于保持水分和皮肤弹性。

此外，芦荟凝胶可以软化面部毛发，使其更容易剃须或去除。

男士可以使用女士洗面奶吗？

其实，偶尔使用女士洗面奶洗脸也没关系脸，因为几乎所有成分都是相同的。 

 

正如之前所解释的男士洗面奶通常有一定的附加成分成分。

添加这种成分可以软化面部毛发或帮助减少引起痤疮的细菌的生长。

男士洁面皂中的其他成分与女士洁面皂相同，例如表面活性剂、脂肪酸或肥皂。

那么，您需要注意的是所使用的洗面奶的类型。

事实上，你使用的产品是针对女性还是男性并不重要。 

最重要的是选择适合自己肤质的产品。

但是，不建议女性使用男性洗面奶。男士洗面奶中含有的附加成分往往更刺激。

因此，男士洗面奶可能不适合女性脸部皮肤敏感，容易出现皮肤问题。

Compared to facial soap for men, facial soap for women is more common and easier to find. There are even more women's facial soap products. Therefore, most men often use women's facial soap when cleaning their face. However, is there a difference between men's and women's facial soap?

Differences of facial skin of men and women

 
 
 
A scientific study in the International journal of women's dermatology (2018) looked at the differences in the facial skin of men and women. 

This study conducted a scientific review of 1,070 pieces of literature. The results of the study show that the facial skin of men and women tends to be different.

On average, men have oilier skin than women. 

This is due to the amount of collagen (a type of protein) in the middle layer of skin (dermis) in men taller than women.

 

Another thing that differentiates the skin of the two is the habit of men shaving facial hair, both mustaches and beards.

Men need to do exfoliate more regularly to slow facial hair growth.

Because of these differences in skin conditions and habits, men's facial care methods and the skincare products used, including facial soap, should also be different from women's.

Differences of men's and women's facial soaps

Men's facial soap has several differences from women's facial soap. However, most of the content is still the same.

The following are a number of differences in general facial soap ingredients for men and women.

1. Contains exfoliants

Apart from cleaning, men's facial soap also exfoliates the skin.Both have important goals in keep skin healthy and radiant.

Exfoliants and cleansers can be found in one men's facial soap product.This is to make skin care steps easier for men who tend to skip double cleansing.

The exfoliant content in facial soap aims to remove dead skin cells, dust, dirt and excess oil on facial skin.

In addition, the exfoliant content helps slow the growth of facial hair, such as beards and moustaches.

2. Contains antiseptic or antibacterial

Men's facial soap generally also contains antibacterial ingredients, such as benzoyl peroxide or benzoyl peroxide.

 

Benzoyl peroxide is an ingredient used to treat acne

This active ingredient works as an antiseptic to reduce the number of germs and bacteria on the surface of the skin.

Men's facial skin produces more oil, causing dust and dirt to stick easily.

This condition supports the bacteria that cause facial acne to grow quickly.

Therefore, men's facial soap is not only for cleaning the face, but also helps get rid of acne and caring for oily skin types.

3. Contains aloe vera gel

Aloe vera gel can be found in facial soap or other women's facial care products.

However, aloe vera gel is included in men's facial soap products.

Aloe vera gel is known to be useful for maintaining moisture and skin elasticity.

In addition, aloe vera gel can soften facial hair making it easier to shave or remove.

Can men use women's-facial soap?

Actually, it's fine if you occasionally use women's facial soap for wash face because almost all the ingredients are the same. 

 

As previously explained facial soap for men usually has certain additional ingredients.

The addition of this ingredient can soften facial hair or help reduce the growth of acne-causing bacteria.

Other ingredients in men's facial soap are the same as women's facial soap, for example surfactants, fatty acids, or soap.

Well, what you have to pay attention to is the type of facial soap that will be used.

Actually, it doesn't matter whether the product you use is aimed at women or men. 

The most important thing is to choose products that suit your skin type.

However, women are not advised to use facial soap for men. The additional ingredients contained in facial soap for men tend to be harsher.

Therefore, men's facial soap may not be suitable for women's facial skin which is sensitive and prone to skin problems.

与孩子一起做饭的插图 (pexels.com/Monstera)

斋月期间，您可以利用空闲时间尝试在厨房花更多时间。一些对提高技能非常有帮助的活动是尝试用新食谱做饭。

Instead of spending your ngabuburit time lazing around, it's better if you try this ngabuburit idea. Not only will you be more productive, your Ramadan will be more meaningful and not in vain!

1. Trying new recipes

illustration of cooking with children (pexels.com/Monstera)

During Ramadan, you can use your free time to try spending more time in the kitchen. Some activities that are very helpful in improving skills are trying to cook with new recipes.

This can be done by trying to make your own food for breaking the fast or sahur. No need to immediately experiment with difficult foods. Starting with a simple menu is already progress, you know.

2. Cycling

cycling illustration (pexels.com/Munbaik Cycling Clothing)

For those of you who want to maintain a healthy body while fasting, food is the main concern, but exercising is also necessary. This is done to maintain the body's endurance so that it is more fit during other activities.

If you want to exercise while waiting for sunset, one of the ideas you can do for ngabuburit is to take a leisurely bike ride. Apart from making your body healthy, your mind will also be refreshed because you can walk around your house while waiting for the time to break the fast.

3. Write

illustration of someone writing a negotiation text (pexels.com/George Milton)

One of the ngabuburit ideas that can also increase productivity in Ramadan is writing. This activity can help you hone your ability to compose written works and improve your intellect, you know.

Moreover, you can write various kinds of information related to the fasting month, such as culinary references, tips for maintaining health, and even religious matters.

4.Shop for your own cooking ingredients

shopping illustration on the market (pexels.com/Sam Lion)

Shopping for your own cooking ingredients is an event that is no less productive. Because, this can help reduce your desire to always buy ready-made dishes for breaking the fast or when sahur arrives.

By doing your own shopping, you can also choose what you want to cook, starting from vegetables, protein sources, fiber foods, to fruit. So that daily nutrition is more fulfilled.

5. Farming

Planting illustration (unsplash/Joshua Lanzarini)

You can also have fun using the time before breaking the fast through farming activities. Doing this activity can improve your mood, make your yard look better, and be useful for your kitchen, if the plants you collect can be eaten.

If you don't have enough land, you can take advantage of the presence of a veranda or balcony. Just prepare a suitable pot and plant the plant seeds so that you can use it as a form of productive activity during fasting.

For those of you who have free time to relax, the five activities above can be used as useful productive activities. Stay healthy and pay attention to the duration of your activities, so that you don't get too tired.

6. Khataman Qur'an

illustration of the Koran (pexels.com/RODNAE Productions)

As long as you are given the opportunity to meet this blessed month, there's no harm in filling your time by reading the Koran. Moreover, in the month of Ramadan all the good things you do will be rewarded with double rewards. 

Therefore, most Muslims often use the month of Ramadan to recite or finish reading the Koran. So, so that it's not too heavy, you can read a few pages in installments while waiting for the time to break your fast.

Well, those are 6 ngabuburit ideas that you can try during the month of Ramadan.Apart from being fun, the activities above are also beneficial for yourself. Come on, try it starting today!

5-cara-mencegah-tubuh-lemas-saat-puasa.zh:
禁食时感到虚弱是正常的。不过，别掉以轻心，好吗？如果不加以控制，虚弱的身体会阻碍日常活动，甚至可能成为健康问题的征兆，你知道。 来吧，在本文中了解如何防止禁食时身体感到虚弱。

身体虚弱通常发生在禁食的初始阶段或最初几周。这种情况的发生是由于体内血糖水平降低的适应过程，使人没有精力。

有些人还可能抱怨禁食期间睡眠困难，导致白天疲劳。虽然这并不总是危险的，但身体虚弱也可能是脱水的迹象。

如果是脱水引起的，身体虚弱一般会伴有其他症状，如口渴、口干、皮肤干燥、不排尿或尿液呈深黄色、头痛和肌肉痉挛等。

以这种方式防止你的身体在禁食期间感到虚弱

其实，只要方法正确，禁食其实是可以减轻疲劳感的。事实上，进行健康的禁食还可以改善睡眠质量并保持良好的心情。

好吧，为了让您的身体在禁食时不会变得虚弱并能够像往常一样进行活动，请执行以下操作：

1。建立睡眠模式

良好的睡眠模式是禁食期间不感到虚弱的关键之一。因此，避免熬夜，每晚睡眠不少于4小时。为了睡得更好，让睡眠氛围更舒适，比如调暗灯光、保持室温凉爽。

如果你还是觉得困，吃完sahur就回去睡觉也可以，不过先等一会儿。除此之外，如果可能的话，留出最多 20 分钟的小睡时间。

2.注意饮食

确保开斋和开斋时食用的每一种食物都含有均衡的营养，包括复合碳水化合物、蛋白质、维生素、矿物质和健康脂肪。吃健康且营养均衡的食物将维持和增强身体免疫力并克服禁食期间的疲劳。

您可以选择的食物类型包括肉类、小麦、绿色蔬菜、坚果和豆腐。这种食物被身体消化的速度较慢，因此可以让您的饱腹感持续更长时间。

但是，请记住，不要吃得过多。吃得过多可能会导致虚弱、胀气，甚至体重增加。

3.获取足够的体液

水分充足的身体肯定会让您在禁食期间变得更健康、更有活力。因此，满足您的需求每天喝大约 2-3 升或 8 杯矿泉水。

为了在禁食期间保持身体水分，您可以采用 2-4-2 公式来满足液体需求，即开斋时喝 2 杯，睡前喝 4 杯，黎明时喝 2 杯。

避免饮用已知具有利尿作用的咖啡、茶或苏打水，这实际上会增加脱水的风险。相反，您可以喝不含糖的果汁作为健康且低热量的替代饮料。

4。定期锻炼

正确的禁食时锻炼可以使您的身体肌肉更强壮，并帮助您有更多的能量进行日常活动。

禁食时，您可以选择低强度的运动类型，例如步行、骑自行车或瑜伽。每天定期进行 30 分钟，每周 3-5 次。

5。考虑服用补充剂

为了帮助满足您的日常营养需求并防止禁食期间身体虚弱，您可以考虑食用补充。与您的医生讨论可以让您的身体充满活力的合适补充剂选择。

医生可以开一些维生素 D、维生素 B12、铁和钙，以减轻禁食时身体的虚弱症状。 您还可以考虑组合补充维生素 C 和锌作为解决方案。

不要让禁食期间的虚弱感降低您的工作效率。 来吧，做好以上的健康习惯，让你的身体更有活力，断食也能顺利运行。

原始文章来源：www.alodokter.com
5-cara-mencegah-tubuh-lemas-saat-puasa.en:
It's normal to feel weak when fasting. However, don't take it lightly, okay? If left unchecked, a weak body can hinder daily activities, and can even be a sign of health problems, you know. Come on, find out how to prevent your body from feeling weak when fasting in this article.

Body weakness is usually experienced during the initial phase or in the first weeks of fasting. This condition can occur due to the adaptation process of decreasing blood sugar levels in the body which makes a person have no energy.

Some people can also complain of difficulty sleeping during fasting which causes fatigue during the day. Although it is not always dangerous, a weak body can also be a sign of dehydration.

If it is caused by dehydration, body weakness will generally be accompanied by other symptoms, such as excessive thirst, dry mouth, dry skin, not urinating or dark yellow urine, headaches and muscle cramps.

Prevent your body from feeling weak during fasting this way

Actually, as long as it is done in the right way, fasting can actually reduce feelings of fatigue. In fact, undergoing healthy fasting can also improve sleep quality and maintain a good mood.

Well, so that your body doesn't get weak when fasting and can carry out your activities as usual, do the following:

1. Establish a sleep pattern

A good sleep pattern is one of the main keys to not getting weak during fasting. Therefore, avoid staying up late and sleep no less than 4 hours every night. To sleep better, make the sleeping atmosphere more comfortable, such as dimming the lights and keeping the room temperature cool.

If you still feel sleepy, it's okay to go back to sleep after eating sahur, but wait a while first. Apart from that, if possible, set aside time for a nap of up to 20 minutes.

2. Pay attention to your diet

Make sure that every food consumed when sahur and breaking the fast contains balanced nutrition, including complex carbohydrates, protein, vitamins, minerals and healthy fats.Eating healthy and nutritionally balanced food will maintain and strengthen body immunity and overcome fatigue during fasting.

Some types of food that you can choose are meat, wheat, green vegetables, nuts and tofu. This food is digested more slowly by the body, so it can make you feel full for longer.

However, remember, don't overeat.Eating more than normal portions risks causing weakness, flatulence, and even weight gain.

3. Get enough body fluids

A hydrated body will certainly make you fitter and more energetic during fasting. So, meet your needs drink mineral water approximately 2–3 liters or 8 glasses every day.

To keep your body hydrated during fasting, you can meet your fluid needs by using the 2-4-2 formula, namely 2 glasses when breaking the fast, 4 glasses before bed, and 2 glasses at dawn.

Avoid consuming coffee, tea or soda which are known to have a diuretic effect, which can actually increase the risk of dehydration. Instead, you can drink fruit juice without sugar as a healthy and low-calorie alternative drink.

4. Do regular exercise

Exercise while fasting which is done correctly can make your body muscles stronger and help you have more energy to carry out your daily activities.

When fasting, you can choose a type of exercise that is low intensity, such as walking, cycling or yoga. Do it regularly for 30 minutes a day, 3–5 times a week.

5. Consider taking supplements

To help meet your daily nutritional needs and prevent body weakness during fasting, you can consider consuming supplement. Discuss with your doctor about suitable supplement options that can make your body energized.

Several types of vitamins that doctors can prescribe to make the body less weak when fasting are vitamin D, vitamin B12, iron and calcium. You can also consider a combination supplement vitamin C and zinc as a solution.

Don't let feeling weak during fasting reduce your productivity. Come on, do the healthy habits above so that your body will be more energetic and fasting can run smoothly.

不仅味道鲜美，每一种典型的年味食物对于中国人来说都蕴藏着深刻的意义和哲理。更有趣的是，每一种食物都被认为会给吃它的人带来好运。

那么，有哪些选择呢？以下是 8 种被认为能带来好运的典型农历新年食物：

篮子蛋糕

每逢过年，蛋糕都是必不可少的。篮子蛋糕味道香甜，质地耐嚼，人们相信篮子蛋糕会比去年带来更好的运气、健康、财富和幸福。篮子蛋糕叠放的排列方式也有很深的寓意，象征着高薪高位的运气。

纸杯蛋糕

由米粉、纸杯蛋糕或发糕制成，是典型的中国新年食品，形状为盛开的花朵。据说花瓣的形状象征着财富的增长。许多人称其为“发财蛋糕”，因为人们相信纸杯蛋糕可以带来好运。事实上，花瓣越多，你获得的运气就越多。

我的蛋糕

我的蛋糕的特点是它的贝壳形状和漂亮的鲜红颜色。这种由糯米粉制成的传统糕点，里面装满青豆，象征着繁荣。我的蛋糕上印有农历新年字母、图片或吉祥符号的模具并不罕见。

月饼

接下来是月饼或称为月饼。与以往的糕点不同，月饼是一种典型的农历新年甜食，形状类似皮亚饼，里面含有豆沙。其圆形如月亮，象征圆满。因此，人们相信吃月饼可以为来年带来好运、繁荣和身体健康。

八角糖果

八角形盒装糖果或称为团聚托盘是包装在八角形容器中的糖果的集合。每一颗糖果都有它自己的意义。就像蜜瓜象征着健康，红西瓜象征着幸福，金橘橙象征着吉祥如意。

同时，干椰子糖象征着团圆或亲情，莲子形状的糖象征着多子多福，龙眼糖象征着多子多孙，最后花生象征着祈求长寿。

饺子

也称为饺子，是一种古老的中国钱形饺子，象征着繁荣。人们相信，过年吃饺子的多少，预示着新年的收入。饺子含有清爽的牛肉和蔬菜。为了使它更加美味，饺子通常在吃之前沾上酱油和姜。

Lumpia

春卷呈金黄色，形似金条，是典型的农历新年食品，被认为可以带来好运和财富。和一般的春卷类似，这个过年春卷里面有肉片和各种蔬菜。别忘了蘸上蚝油、米酒、酱油和芝麻油的混合物。保证更加美味。

万岁面条

除了生日庆祝活动外，长寿面往往是农历新年庆祝活动的必备食品。顾名思义，这些炒面象征着长寿和吉祥。

Not only does it have a delicious taste, every typical Chinese New Year food also holds deep meaning and philosophy for the Chinese people. What's more interesting is that every food is believed to bring good luck to those who eat it.

So, what are the options? Here are 8 typical Chinese New Year foods that are believed to bring good luck:

Basket Cake

Bakecakes are never absent at every Chinese New Year celebration.Having a sweet taste and chewy texture, basket cakes are believed to bring better luck, health, wealth and happiness than the previous year. The arrangement of basket cakes stacked on top of each other also has a deep meaning, namely symbolizing luck in higher salaries and positions.

Cupcakes

Made from rice flour, cupcakes or fa gao is a typical Chinese New Year food in the shape of a blooming flower. It is said that the shape of the flower petals symbolizes growing fortune.Many people call it “prosperity cake” because the cupcake is believed to bring good luck. In fact, the more petals on it, the more luck you will get.

My Cake

The characteristic of my cake is its shell-like shape and beautiful bright red color. This traditional cake made from sticky rice flour filled with green beans symbolizes prosperity. It is not uncommon for my cakes to be printed with molds that have letters, pictures or good luck symbols for Chinese New Year.

Moon Cake

Next is moon cake or known as moon cake. Different from previous cakes, moon cakes are a typical Chinese New Year sweet food that resemble pia and contain red bean paste. Its round shape resembles the moon, symbolizing wholeness.So if we eat mooncakes, it is believed that it can bring good fortune, prosperity and complete health for the next year.

Octagonal Sweets

Octagonal boxed sweets or known as tray of togetherness are a collection of sweets packaged in an octagonal container. Each sweet has its own meaning. Like candied melons symbolize health, red watermelon symbolizes happiness, and kumquat oranges symbolize good luck and prosperity.

Meanwhile, dried coconut sweets symbolize togetherness or kinship, sweets shaped like lotus seeds symbolize fertility, longan sweets symbolize many children, and finally peanuts symbolize prayers for long life.

Dumplings

Also known as jiaozi, it is an ancient Chinese money-shaped dumpling that symbolizes prosperity. According to belief, the amount of dumplings consumed on Chinese New Year predicts the amount of money you will earn when entering the new year.Dumpling contains refreshing beef and vegetables. To make it even more delicious, dumpling is usually dipped in soy sauce and ginger before eating.

Lumpia

Golden brown in color, resembling gold bars, spring rolls are a typical Chinese New Year food that is believed to bring good luck and wealth. Similar to spring rolls in general, this Chinese New Year spring roll is filled with pieces of meat and various vegetables. Don't forget to dip it with a mixture of oyster sauce, rice wine, soy sauce and sesame oil. Guaranteed to be even more delicious.

Long Live Noodles

Apart from being served at birthday celebrations, longevity noodles are often a mandatory food at Chinese New Year celebrations. As the name suggests, these fried noodles symbolize long life and good luck.

如果您拥有各种铁资产，或以铁作为支撑材料的建筑，那么给铁涂上一层良好的油漆很重要。这样，铁就可以更好地免受各种环境因素的影响，并且更能抵抗腐蚀的风险。

有多种类型的油漆可以为您推荐。根据您的涂层需求进行选择，然后确保使用最好的产品，以便获得最佳保护。

要识别油漆的类型，您还需要根据要涂漆的铁的面积了解油漆的变体。了解各种铁漆，为您的铁资产提供最佳保护。

根据您的需要选择合适的铁漆类型

为了保持熨斗良好的保养，强烈建议给它涂一层油漆。以下是推荐用于保护您的铁资产的各种类型的油漆。

1。油性涂料

您可以考虑的第一个建议是油性涂料。由于它利用了油的防水特性，因此该涂料可以保护铁质资产免受水的影响，而水是导致腐蚀的因素之一。

这种涂料可以提供鲜艳的色彩，并可以隐藏铁表面的各种瑕疵。其持久的特性也使其成为一个不错的选择。

但是，建议在熨斗上涂底漆后再涂油漆。

2.杜科涂料

Duco 漆或通常所说的腻子漆也是您可以考虑的一种铁漆。 

这种涂料通常用作表面覆盖层或通常所说的底漆。通过涂覆表面，它会显得更致密、更光滑。

3.环氧漆

下一个推荐的优质铁漆是环氧漆，它是底漆的一种。对于包括铁在内的各种金属资产，通常使用这种涂料。例如针对各类工业的开发以及汽车、船舶等交通设备的制造。

这种涂料的优点是能够抵抗天气挑战和腐蚀风险。其相对较强的粘合力也可以帮助后面的饰面层，使所有东西都能达到最佳粘合效果。

4。醇酸漆

接下来有一种醇酸漆，附着力强，耐腐蚀。然而，这种涂料的强度不足以承受阳光的照射，因此被广泛用于建筑物的内部涂装。

5。聚氨酯漆

下一个好的铁漆是聚氨酯漆，它也是底漆。这种涂料非常适合经常暴露在阳光直射下的各种铁质资产，因为它具有防紫外线成分。

除此之外，这种涂料还可以提供最好的保护，将腐蚀风险降至最低。

6。效果涂料

效果漆或又称质感漆，可以为待涂金属表面提供形状、颜色和渐变效果。

这种类型的油漆非常常用，因为它可以为铁资产的表面提供美学价值。如果您想要不同的颜色细微差别，那么这可能是正确的选择。

7。铝漆

下一种可以保护铁资产的涂料是铝漆。这种涂料是由铝颗粒与清漆混合而成。

这种涂料相当优越，因为它耐电、耐腐蚀、耐各种天气。由于具有良好的耐用性，这种涂料经常用于建造油箱、汽油箱和散热器。

除了铁或各种其他类型的金属外，这种涂料还可以应用于木质材料。

各类铁漆的比较

如果你看了上面的各种解释，你就可以根据你的铁资产的需要来选择油漆的类型了。 

比如户外需要，最好使用抗紫外线的涂料。除此之外，耐用程度也是一个考虑因素，这样您就不会做出错误的选择。

如果从底漆或面漆的角度来看，您可以使用各种组合来获得最佳保护。

用于铁漆包装

If you have various iron assets, or construction with iron as a supporting material, it is important to give the iron a good coat of paint. That way, iron is better protected from various environmental factors and is more resistant to the risk of corrosion.

There are various types of paint that can be recommended for you. Choose according to your coating needs, then make sure you use the best product so that the protection is optimal.

To recognize the type of paint you also need to know the paint variant according to the area of ​​the iron to be painted. Get to know various iron paints, for optimal protection of your iron assets.

Good Types of Iron Paint according to Your Needs

To keep the iron well maintained, it is highly recommended to give it a coat of paint. The following are various types of paint that can be recommended for protecting your iron assets.

1. Oil-Based Paint

The first recommendation that you can consider is oil-based paint. Because it utilizes the water-resistant properties of oil, this paint can protect iron assets from water which is one of the factors that causes corrosion.

This type of paint can provide bright colors and can hide various flaws on the iron surface. Its long-lasting nature also makes it a good choice.

However, it is recommended to apply oil paint after you have coated the iron using primer.

2. Duco Paint

Duco paint or what is often called putty paint is also a type of iron paint that you can consider. 

This paint is generally used as a surface cover or what is often called base paint. By coating the surface, it will appear denser and smoother.

3. Epoxy Paint

The next recommendation for good iron paint is epoxy paint which is a type of primer paint. For various metal assets, including iron, this paint is commonly used. For example, for various types of industrial development and the manufacture of transportation equipment such as cars and ships.

The advantage of this type of paint is its resistance to weather challenges and the risk of corrosion. Its relatively strong adhesive power can also help the finishing layer later, so that everything can stick optimally.

4. Alkyd Paint

Next, there is a type of alkyd paint which has strong adhesion and is resistant to corrosion. However, this paint is not strong enough to withstand exposure to sunlight, so it is widely used to coat the inside of buildings.

5. Polyurethane Paint

The next good iron paint is polyurethane paint which is also a primer paint. This type of paint is very suitable for various iron assets that are often exposed to direct sunlight, because it has protective components from ultraviolet rays.

Apart from that, this paint can also provide the best protection to minimize the risk of corrosion.

6. Effect Paint

Effect paint or what is also known as texture paint can provide shape, color and gradation effects for the metal surface to be coated.

This type of paint is quite commonly used because it can provide aesthetic value to the surface of your iron assets. If you want different color nuances, then this could be the right choice.

7. Aluminum Paint

The next type of coating that can protect iron assets is aluminum paint. This paint is made from aluminum particles combined with oil varnish.

This paint is quite superior, because it is resistant to electricity, corrosion and exposure to various types of weather. With this good durability, this paint is often used in the construction of oil tanks, petrol tanks, and radiators.

Apart from iron or various other types of metal, this paint can also be applied to wooden materials.

Comparison of Various Types of Iron Paint

If you look at the various explanations above, you can choose the type of paint according to the needs of your iron assets. 

For example, for outdoor needs, it would be better to use a type of paint that is resistant to ultraviolet rays. Apart from that, the level of durability can also be a consideration so that you don't make the wrong choice.

If you look at it in terms of base paint or finishing paint, you can use various combinations to get optimal protection.

泗水，2025 年 3 月 25 日 – Asia Plastik 组织的开斋活动或 bukber 是一个加强员工与公司管理层之间关系的特殊时刻。该活动于下午 17:00 至 18:00 举行，地点为 Asia Plastik 新办公室的前院，该办公室位于泗水 Jalan Rungkut Industri No. 52。

开斋活动以 Ustad 的布道开始，Asia Plastik 全体员工和工作人员参加了布道。讲道提供了精神上的启迪，并提醒参与者耐心和真诚地禁食的重要性。布道期间，参与者耐心等待，直到开斋时间。

当马格里布​​的祈祷声响起时，在场的所有穆斯林立即开始开斋，享用 Asia Plastik 提供的零食。随后，他们进行小净，并聚集在一起进行昏礼祈祷，以感谢斋月期间所给予的祝福。

服务结束后，将米饭和其他菜肴分发给所有参与者，然后一起享用晚餐。这个团聚的时刻为所有员工提供了一个相互交流、加强关系、增强兄弟情谊的机会。

这项活动的主要希望是，在这个神圣的月份一起开斋可以增进整个 Asia Plastik 大家庭之间的友谊。除此之外，类似的活动也有望成为一个在工作场所互相支持、保持团结的机会。

这项开斋活动无疑是维持员工和谐关系的有效方式，同时也能利用斋月的势头来接近阿拉SWT。
buka-bersama-asia-plastik.en:
Surabaya, 25 March 2025 – The iftar activity or bukber organized by Asia Plastik is a special moment that strengthens the relationship between employees and the company's management. The event, which took place in the afternoon from 17.00 to 18.00, was held in the front yard of Asia Plastik's new office, located on Jalan Rungkut Industri No. 52, Surabaya.

The breaking fast activity began with a sermon delivered by a Ustad, which was attended by all Asia Plastik staff and staff. The sermon provided spiritual enlightenment as well as serving as a reminder to the participants of the importance of fasting with patience and sincerity. During the sermon, the participants waited patiently until it was time to break their fast.

When the Maghrib call to prayer sounded, all Muslims present immediately broke their fast by enjoying snacks provided by Asia Plastik. After that, they performed ablution and gathered together to perform the Maghrib prayer as a form of gratitude for the blessings given during the holy month of Ramadan.

After carrying out the service, rice and other dishes are distributed to all participants to then enjoy dinner together. This moment of togetherness provides an opportunity for all employees to interact with each other, strengthen relationships and strengthen a sense of brotherhood.

The main hope of this activity is that breaking fast together in this blessed month can increase friendship between the entire Asia Plastik family. Apart from that, events like this are also expected to be an opportunity to support each other and maintain unity in the workplace.

This breaking fast activity is certainly an effective way to maintain harmonious relationships between employees, as well as taking advantage of the momentum of Ramadan to get closer to Allah SWT.

sebentar-lagi-imlek-nih-ini-dia-hal-yang.zh:
在印尼，庆祝农历新年是华人社区的重要传统。中国新年期间有一些传统习俗始终存在。以下是您在印度尼西亚农历新年期间可以做的事情。

<强>1。家居清洁及装饰

在过年之前，不少印尼华人家庭都会进行一次彻底的房屋大扫除，以迎接新的一年。房子以红色和金色装饰，人们相信这会带来好运和幸福。

<强>2。家庭团聚

农历新年是一家人团聚在一起庆祝的时刻。通常会有一个家庭聚餐活动，称为家庭团聚，远方的家人会回到父母家一起庆祝。

<强>3。典型的中国新年食品

为了庆祝这个庆祝活动，我们准备了各种典型的中国新年菜肴。一些典型的菜肴包括象征长寿的长面条、象征繁荣的鱼以及篮子饼和花瓣饼等传统糕点。

<强>4。送红包

一个非常著名的传统是向儿童和年轻人赠送红包，即装满钱的红包，作为新年好运和美好祝愿的象征。

<强>5。巴龙赛和狮子

巴龙萨和狮子表演是印度尼西亚农历新年庆祝活动不可或缺的一部分。这些表演在家庭和企业门前举行，以辟邪、带来好运和幸福。

<强>6。祈祷和奉献

作为庆祝农历新年的一部分，印度尼西亚的许多儒教徒和佛教徒都会参观寺庙或寺院祈祷并向神明供奉。

7. Cap Go Meh

Cap Go Meh 是农历新年后第 15 天庆祝的庆祝活动，这标志着农历新年系列庆祝活动的结束。这些庆祝活动通常包括游行、晚宴和文化表演。

印度尼西亚的伊姆莱克传统反映了这个国家丰富的文化和种族多样性。尽管这一传统起源于华人社会，但庆祝农历新年已成为整个印尼文化的一个组成部分。社会各阶层都参与庆祝并尊重庆祝活动。

原始文章来源：jakarta.akurat
sebentar-lagi-imlek-nih-ini-dia-hal-yang.en:
In Indonesia, celebrating Chinese New Year is an important tradition for the Chinese community. There are several traditions during Chinese New Year that are always present. The following are things you can do during Chinese New Year in Indonesia.

1. Home Cleaning and Decoration

Before welcoming Chinese New Year, many Chinese families in Indonesia carry out a thorough house cleaning to welcome the new year.The house is decorated in red and gold, which is believed to bring good luck and happiness.

2. Family Reunion

Chinese New Year is a time when family members gather to celebrate together. Usually there is a family dinner event called a family reunion where family members who live far away will return to their parents' house to celebrate together.

3. Typical Chinese New Year Food

There are various typical Chinese New Year dishes prepared to celebrate this celebration.Some typical dishes include long noodles which symbolize long life, fish which symbolizes prosperity, and traditional cakes such as basket cakes and flower petal cakes.

4. Giving Angpao

s

One very famous tradition is giving angpao, namely red envelopes filled with money, to children and younger people as a symbol of good luck and good wishes for the new year.

5. Barongsai and Lion

Barongsa and liong performances are an integral part of Chinese New Year celebrations in Indonesia. These performances are held in front of homes and businesses to ward off evil spirits and bring good luck and happiness.

6. Prayers and Offerings

Many Confucians and Buddhists in Indonesia visit temples or monasteries to pray and make offerings to the gods as part of Chinese New Year celebrations.

7. Cap Go Meh

Cap Go Meh is a celebration celebrated on the 15th day after Chinese New Year, which marks the end of the series of Chinese New Year celebrations.These celebrations are often filled with parades, dinner parties, and cultural performances.

Imlek traditions in Indonesia reflect the rich culture and ethnic diversity of this country. Although this tradition originates from Chinese society, Chinese New Year celebrations are an integral part of Indonesian culture as a whole. Where all levels of society participate in celebrating and respecting the celebration.

perayaan-natal-asia-group-yang-penuh-keb.zh:
泗水，2024 年 12 月 24 日 - 2024 年 12 月 21 日亚洲集团圣诞节庆祝活动在泗水萨玛托诺富特酒店宴会厅度过了一个充满幸福和团聚的夜晚。该活动于 17:00 至 20:00 WIB 邀请整个亚洲集团大家庭以热情、欢乐和团结的方式庆祝耶稣基督的诞生。

庆祝活动以茶歇开始，提供了各种饮品和小吃，营造出热烈的气氛来欢迎嘉宾。随后，敬拜活动在主持人的带领下开始，随后由亚洲Pramulia总总监Ricky先生致辞。 Ricky先生在致辞中表示，希望这个圣诞节时刻能够成为亚洲集团所有成员加强团结的一个点。

当神父们分别以德约科先生、戴迪先生和阿里尔先生为代表发表圣诞印象和祝词时，气氛变得更加庄严。他们各自传达了圣诞节带来平安与欢乐的意义，并邀请所有与会者感恩上帝的恩典。

演讲结束后，仪式在齐声歌唱中继续进行，掌声和欢呼声在诺富特酒店宴会厅回荡。参加者都是Asia Pramulia和Asia Plastik的员工，看上去非常热情，高举双手，热情地唱歌。还举行了圣夜时刻，参与者用手机手电筒作为光的象征，取代了传统的蜡烛。

此次活动还向 Surya 疗养院捐赠了物品，该疗养院是亚洲集团为他人提供社会关怀的一部分。除了敬拜之余，亚洲普拉穆利亚和亚洲塑料工作人员的合唱表演让活动更加热闹。Asia Plastik 合唱团在舞蹈的伴奏下表演了爪哇歌曲的混合曲，赢得了所有参与者的笑声和热烈的掌声。

当晚的欢乐时光以激动人心的游戏和各种诱人的奖品结束，激动人心的游戏以Gopay余额最大、钥匙最多的拥有者开始。还有微波炉、两门冰箱、电视等形式的门奖，以及通过球和旋转轮抽取的最多 5 克黄金。

兴奋过后，大家合影留念，记录下充满幸福的团圆时刻。最后，活动以集体晚宴结束，加强了亚洲集团大家庭之间的兄弟情谊。亚洲集团希望通过此次活动，为全体员工及其家人带来祝福，并通过团聚和关爱他人来荣耀上帝的名。
perayaan-natal-asia-group-yang-penuh-keb.en:
Surabaya, 24 December 2024 - A night full of happiness and togetherness enveloped the Novotel Samator Surabaya Ballroom at the Asia Group Christmas celebration 21 December 2024. The event which took place from 17.00 to 20.00 WIB invited the entire Asia Group family to celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ with enthusiasm, joy and solidarity.

The celebration began with a coffee break which served a variety of drinks and snacks, creating a warm atmosphere to welcome guests. After that, the worship program began with the MC guiding the activities, followed by remarks from Mr. Ricky, Main Director of Asia Pramulia. In his speech, Mr. Ricky expressed his hope that this Christmas moment would become a point to strengthen togetherness for all members of the Asia Group.

The atmosphere became more solemn when the priests gave Christmas impressions and messages, each represented by Mr. Djoko, Mr. Deddy, and Mr. Ariel. Each of them conveyed the meaning of Christmas which brings peace and joy, and invited all attendees to be grateful for God's grace.

After the speech, the service continued with singing together, applause and cheers that echoed in the Novotel Ballroom. The participants, both Asia Pramulia and Asia Plastik employees, looked very enthusiastic, raising their hands and singing enthusiastically. A holy night moment was also held, where participants used cellphone flashlights as a symbol of light, replacing traditional candles.

The event was also marked by giving offerings to the Surya Nursing Home, which is part of Asia Group's social care for others. Apart from worship, the event was even more lively with a choir performance from Asia Pramulia and Asia Plastik staff.A medley of Javanese songs performed by the Asia Plastik choir, accompanied by dancing, invited laughter and loud applause from all participants.

The evening's fun ended with exciting games and various attractive prizes, the exciting games started with the largest Gopay balance, the owner of the most keys. There are also door prizes in the form of a microwave, 2 door refrigerator, television, up to 5 grams of gold, drawn via ball and spin wheel.

After all the excitement, the participants took photos together to capture moments of togetherness full of happiness. In closing, the event ended with a group dinner, strengthening the ties of brotherhood among the Asia Group family.Through this event, Asia Group hopes that this Christmas celebration can bring blessings to all employees and their families, as well as glorifying God's name through togetherness and caring for others.

jangaan-lemes-simak-tips-untuk-memulai-t.zh:
您是否知道明年的成功不仅仅取决于您在到来时所做的事情，还取决于您从现在开始的事情。及早准备是让 2025 年成为最好的一年的关键。那么，为什么不从今天开始采取措施呢？您现在可以开始以下七件事，为更成功、更快乐和更有意义的一年做好准备。

1。提高对技术的理解

你无法回避技术，因为现在生活的几乎所有方面都与它相关。无论是工作、娱乐还是沟通，技术始终是重要的组成部分。从学习操作新软件等基本技能开始，到了解人工智能或区块链等技术趋势。

科技不仅可以帮助您在工作中保持领先地位，还可以让生活变得更加高效。从现在开始，不要害怕在技术领域探索和学习新事物。您现在所做的一点努力将是对未来的一项巨大投资。

2。优先考虑心理健康

生活并非没有挑战。有时候，你心里的负担太重，让你感到不知所措。因此，保持心理健康与保持身体健康同样重要。尝试养成一些小习惯，例如冥想、写日记，或者只是从繁忙的日程中休息一下。

如果您觉得有需要，请毫不犹豫地寻求专业帮助。请记住，良好的心理健康将使您更好地准备好面对明年的所有障碍。从现在开始，因为幸福是你的权利。

3。提高金融素养

拥有很多钱却不知道如何管理，就像一个漏水的桶，最终会被浪费掉。金融知识是实现财务自由所必须具备的技能。开始学习制定预算、了解投资，甚至尝试使用黄金或共同基金等新工具进行储蓄。

诸如此类的小步骤将帮助您更明智地管理财务。这样，您就可以在 2025 年开始时无需担心财务问题。

4。养成学习习惯

世界在不断发展，只有肯学习的人才能生存。从读书、参加在线课程到尝试新的爱好，一切都可以成为拓宽知识面的令人兴奋的方式。

不要把自己限制在一个领域，你了解的东西越多，你面对未来的准备就越充分。请记住，学习不仅仅是为了取得好成绩，更是为了个人的持续发展。

5。建立更有意义的关系

在忙碌的生活中，有时我们会忘记身边的人是多么宝贵。今年，尝试给予家人、朋友或伴侣更多的时间和关注。良好的人际关系不仅能让你快乐，还能成为你面临挑战时的支持源泉。

发送一条简单的消息，邀请他们一起吃饭，或者只是分享故事。牢固的关系是充满信心地面对未来的重要基础。

6。开始更可持续的生活方式

明年，人们的环境意识将会增强。为什么不现在就开始呢？

采取一些小措施，例如自带水瓶、减少一次性塑料的使用或选择环保产品。这不仅对地球有好处，而且还能让您感到更有责任感，为世界做出积极贡献。

7。设定明确的目标和计划

没有目标，你就会毫无方向地随波逐流。开始写下您想要在 2025 年实现的目标。将大目标分解为您现在就可以开始的小步骤。

例如，如果您想过上更健康的生活，可以从每天15分钟的轻度运动开始。通过仔细的计划，您将更加专注并有动力继续前进。

2025 年可能看起来还很遥远，但相信我，时间会过得很快。您今天开始的行动将决定结果。


原始文章来源：www.idntimes.com
jangaan-lemes-simak-tips-untuk-memulai-t.en:
Did you know that success next year is not just about what you do when it arrives, but also what you start from now. Early preparation is the key to making 2025 your best year. So, why not start taking steps today? Here are seven things you can start now to prepare for a more successful, happier and more meaningful year.

1.Improve understanding of technology

You can't avoid technology, because almost all aspects of life are now connected to it. Whether it's work, entertainment, or communication, technology is always an important part. Starting from learning basic skills, such as operating new software , to understanding technology trends such as AI or blockchain.

Technology can not only help you stay relevant in the world of work, but also make life more efficient.From now on, don't be afraid to explore and learn new things in the field of technology. The little effort you make now will be a big investment in the future.

2. Prioritize mental health

Life is not free from challenges.Sometimes, the burden on your mind is too heavy and makes you feel overwhelmed. Therefore, maintaining mental health is as important as maintaining physical health. Try starting small habits like meditation,journaling, or just taking a break from your busy schedule.

If you feel the need, don't hesitate to seek professional help. Remember, good mental health will make you better prepared to face all obstacles in the next year. Start now, because happiness is your right.

3. Improve financial literacy

Having a lot of money without knowing how to manage it is like having a leaky bucket, which ends up being wasted. Financial literacy is a skill that you must have to achieve financial freedom. Start learning to make a budget, understand investments, or even try saving in new instruments such as gold or mutual funds.

Small steps like these will help you manage your finances more wisely. That way, you can start 2025 without worrying about finances.

4. Build Study Habits

The world continues to develop, and only those who are willing to learn can survive. Starting from reading books, taking online courses to trying new hobbies, everything can be an exciting way to broaden your knowledge.

Don't limit yourself to just one area, the more things you know, the more prepared you will be to face the future. Remember, studying is not just to get good grades, but also to continue to develop as an individual.

5. Build more meaningful relationships

In the midst of our busy lives, sometimes we forget how valuable the people around us are. This year, try to give more time and attention to family, friends, or your partner. A good relationship not only makes you happy, but also becomes a source of support when you face challenges.

Send a simple message, invite them to eat together, or just share stories. Strong relationships are an important foundation for facing the future with confidence.

6. Start a more sustainable lifestyle

Next year, awareness of the environment will increase. Why not start now?

Take small steps such as bringing your own drinking bottle, reducing the use of single-use plastic, or choosing environmentally friendly products. Not only is it good for the planet, this habit also makes you feel more responsible and makes a positive contribution to the world.

7. Set clear goals and plans

Without a goal, you will just drift without direction. Start writing down what you want to achieve in 2025. Break big goals into small steps that you can start now.

For example, if you want to live a healthier life, you can start with 15 minutes of light exercise every day. With careful planning, you will be more focused and have the motivation to keep moving forward.

2025 may still seem far away, but believe me, time will pass quickly.What you start today will determine what the results will be.


original article source: www.idntimes.com

inilah-makanan-natal-khas-indonesia-pali.zh:
每个重要的庆祝日肯定都有自己的特色，圣诞节也不例外。圣诞节到来时，人们会进行许多不同的传统活动，并提供各种美食菜单。在印尼，还有来自各地的各种典型的印尼圣诞美食。

这道主菜是平安夜的必备菜肴。你好奇发生了什么吗？来吧，请看下面的全文！

1.克拉珀塔特

如果您在美娜多庆祝圣诞节，您可以尝试 klappertaart。味道鲜美，奶油味，撒上肉桂粉更美味。

2. Arsik调味鱼

北苏门答腊岛典型的 Arsik 调味鱼将香料与独特的成分结合在一起。使用的典型香料包括帕蒂卡拉酸、kecombrang 花和细香葱。真的很好吃，你知道！

3.黄酱鱼

来自安汶的黄酱鱼是用青葱、大蒜、石栗和姜黄混合烹制的。是的，这条鱼来自金枪鱼。

<跨度>4。猪脚蛋糕

Poporcis蛋糕与煎饼相似，但尺寸较小。质地柔软，味道甜美。  为了让它更加美味，可以在上面撒上一点糖粉。

5。黎加黎加鸡

尽管它是日常配菜，但瑞卡-瑞卡鸡肉创意作品经常在圣诞节活动中供应，尤其是在美娜多。这种经过红香料加工的鸡肉味道很辣，配上热米饭吃非常美味。

6。纳斯塔尔

纳斯塔尔通常在特殊的日子供应，包括圣诞节。这种干蛋糕含有菠萝酱，具有诱人的黄色外观。味道是酸、甜、咸的结合。

7. Woku Belanga 鱼

woku belanga 鱼菜由用香料和黄酱烹制的金枪鱼组成。味道往往辛辣但美味，尤其是与热白米饭一起食用时。 仅供参考，woku belanga 鱼菜单经常在美娜多的圣诞节活动中提供。


所以这些是圣诞节可以吃的食物。要在烹饪时包装厨房香料，请不要忘记使用 Asia Plastik 的香料罐！
inilah-makanan-natal-khas-indonesia-pali.en:
Every important celebration day definitely has its own characteristics, including Christmas. When Christmas comes, many various traditions are carried out and various culinary menus are served. In Indonesia, there are also a variety of typical Indonesian Christmas foods from various regions.

This mainstay dish is a must have on Christmas Eve. Are you curious about what's going on? Come on, see in full below!

1. Klappertaart

If you celebrate Christmas in Manado, you can try klappertaart. It tastes delicious and creamy, sprinkle with cinnamon powder to make it even more delicious.

2. Arsik Seasoned Fish

Arsik seasoned fish typical of North Sumatra combines spices with unique ingredients. Typical spices used include patikala acid, kecombrang flowers, and chives. It's really delicious, you know!

3. Yellow Sauce Fish

Fish in yellow sauce from Ambon is cooked with a mixture of shallots, garlic, candlenuts and turmeric. The fish is from tuna, yes.

4. Poporcis Cake

Poporcis cakes are similar to pancakes, but smaller in size. The texture is soft with a sweet taste.  To make it even more delicious, add a sprinkle of powdered sugar on top.

5. Rica-rica Chicken

Even though it is a daily side dish, rica-rica chicken creations are often served at Christmas events, especially in Manado.This processed chicken meat with red spices tastes spicy so it is delicious when eaten with warm rice.

6. Nastar

Nastar is often served on special days, including Christmas. This dry cake contains pineapple jam with an attractive yellow appearance. The taste is a combination of sour, sweet and savory.

7. Woku Belanga Fish

The woku belanga fish dish consists of tuna cooked with spices and yellow sauce. The taste tends to be spicy but delicious, especially when eaten with warm white rice. FYI, the woku belanga fish menu is often served at Christmas events in Manado.


So those are the foods that can be served at Christmas.To pack your kitchen spices when cooking, don't forget to use the Spice Jar from Asia Plastik!

Virgin coconut oil  has become a hot topic of conversation in the world of health and beauty. This natural coconut oil is not only used in cooking, but also has amazing health benefits.

What are the Benefits of Virgin Coconut Oil?

1. Virgin coconut oil can maintain heart health

VCO contains medium chain fatty acids (MCT) which can help improve heart health.MCT can increase good cholesterol (HDL) levels in the body and reduce bad cholesterol (LDL) levels. By consuming VCO regularly, you can maintain the balance of cholesterol in the body and reduce the risk of heart disease.

2. Improves the immune system

The lauric acid content in VCO has strong antiviral, antibacterial and antifungal properties.Consuming VCO can help improve the immune system and protect the body from infection and disease.

Even though VCO contains fat, the fat contained in VCO is healthy fat which can help increase the body's metabolism.Consuming VCO can increase the number of calories burned in the body, thereby helping in weight loss.

4. Maintain healthy skin

VCO contains vitamin E and essential fatty acids which can help maintain skin moisture and fight signs of aging. Applying VCO directly to the skin can help overcome skin problems such as dry skin, eczema and psoriasis.

5. Virgin coconut oil helps with digestion

VCO has antimicrobial properties which can help eliminate bad bacteria in the digestive tract. Consuming VCO regularly can help improve digestive function, reduce symptoms of intestinal inflammation, and increase nutrient absorption.

VCO can be a natural hair treatment. The nutritional content in VCO helps overcome hair problems such as baldness, damaged hair and dandruff. 

Applying VCO to the hair and scalp can provide moisture, increase hair growth and reduce hair loss.

Medium chain fatty acids in VCO can provide a good source of energy for the brain. Regular consumption of VCO can help improve concentration, improve brain function, and reduce the risk of neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's.

印度尼西亚有一个便宜的度假胜地吗？您确实有必要了解这一点并记下来，以便您更轻松地前往拥有最美丽旅游景点的城市。

提供许多令人惊叹的度假胜地，而且价格实惠。对于那些想在不花很多钱的情况下探索这个国家的美丽的人，下面推荐了印度尼西亚 10 个最新的廉价度假胜地，你知道的！

从迷人的海滩到历史悠久的城市，这些目的地以实惠的价格提供难忘的度假体验。让我们开始你的节俭冒险，发现印度尼西亚的迷人魅力！

印度尼西亚经济实惠的度假胜地推荐

1.茂物 Ciherang 瀑布

首先推荐一个物美价廉的度假胜地是Curug Ciherang，它位于西爪哇省茂物摄政区Sukamakmur区Wargajaya村，是一个令人惊叹的自然旅游胜地，门票价格每人只需30,000印尼盾。

除了欣赏瀑布美景外，游客还可以享受各种游乐设施，如树屋、吊桥、天然游泳池、露营地和拍照打卡点，你懂的！ Ciherang 瀑布每天开放时间为 07:00 至 18:00 WIB，使其成为享受清爽且经济实惠的短期假期的理想场所。

2. Panguk Kediwung 山，日惹

接下来，日惹班图尔摄政区德林戈区曼古南村的潘古克凯迪翁山 (Panguk Kediwung Hill) 是一个自然的旅游胜地，可以欣赏到日出的壮丽景色。

游客只需购买每人 5,000 印尼盾的门票，即可享受各种值得晒在 Instagram 上的拍照地点、轻松的徒步小径和休闲区。这座山每天开放时间为 04:00 至 18:00 WIB，使其成为以实惠的价格欣赏日惹自然美景的理想场所。

3.日惹曼古南松林

这个便宜的旅游推荐再次来自与之前相同的地区，即日惹。日惹的曼古南松林是一个受欢迎的目的地，拥有凉爽的氛围和松林的自然美景。

游客只需购买每人 5,000 印尼盾至 10,000 印尼盾的门票，即可欣赏观景山的广阔森林景观，并可在 Instagram 上拍照留念。还有飞狐等游乐设施以及出境和露营地设施。

曼古南松林每天开放，营业时间灵活，非常适合享受清晨或傍晚的凉爽氛围。

4.玛琅巴图广场

Alun-Alun Batu Malang 是东爪哇省玛琅的热门旅游目的地。这个地方免费参观，每天24小时开放。游乐设施包括摩天轮、旋转木马、舞蹈喷泉、儿童游乐场、滑板公园和烹饪区。

部分游乐设施的运营时间为 09:00 至 21:00 WIB。其他设施包括卫生间、休息区和停车区。 Alun-Alun Batu Malang 适合与家人和朋友一起游览。

5.果阿西纳海滩，玛琅

此推荐位于东爪哇玛琅的果阿西纳海滩，以其自然景观和历史洞穴而闻名。门票每人约10,000印尼盾。提供的游乐设施和活动包括洞穴探险、浮潜、游泳、欣赏日落、露营、钓鱼和摄影。这个海滩每天 24 小时开放。

设施包括厕所、浴室、小吃摊、停车场，以及浮潜和露营设备租赁。这个海滩适合与家人或朋友一起度假。

6.基杜尔山萨德拉南海滩

接下来是日惹古农基杜尔 (Gunung Kidul) 的萨德拉南海滩 (Sadranan Beach)，以其白色的沙滩和清澈的海水而闻名。门票约为每人 10,000 印尼盾至 15,000 印尼盾。

可用的活动包括浮潜、游泳、香蕉船、划独木舟、露营和摄影。这个海滩每天24小时开放，设有厕所、浴室、小吃摊等设施，提供浮潜设备和露营设备的出租服务，还有停车场。这个海滩适合与家人或朋友一起度假。

7.巴厘岛巴拉坦湖

印度尼西亚廉价旅游的推荐是巴厘岛贝都古的贝拉坦湖。以其山景和凉爽的空气而闻名。门票约为每人 20,000 印尼盾至 50,000 印尼盾。

可用的活动包括参观乌伦达努贝拉坦寺、传统船只和快艇租赁、划独木舟、钓鱼、露营和摄影。该湖每天开放时间为 WITA 08:00 至 18:00。设施包括厕所、浴室、小吃摊、餐厅、停车场和纪念品商店。这个目的地适合家人或朋友度假。

8.龙目岛库塔海滩

此外，龙目岛库塔海滩是西努沙登加拉著名的旅游胜地，沙白，海水清澈。无需入场费，但停车费为 IDR 5,000 至 IDR 10,000。

可用的活动包括冲浪、浮潜、游泳、骑马、玩沙、野餐和摄影。这个海滩每天 24 小时开放。设施包括厕所、浴室、小吃摊、咖啡馆、浮潜和冲浪设备租赁、停车场以及海滩周围的住宿。这个海滩适合与家人或朋友一起度假。

9.塞里布群岛帕里岛

接下来是帕里岛，雅加达千岛群岛中有趣的目的地之一，提供与大自然融为一体的度假体验。游客可以通过浮潜和潜水活动欣赏水下美景。

您可以享受香蕉船和摩托艇等各种水上游乐设施，也可以骑自行车或步行探索岛屿。

门票价格为每人 50,000 印尼盾至 100,000 印尼盾，开放时间为每天早上至晚上。帕里岛是在未受破坏的大自然中度过令人兴奋和清爽的假期的正确选择。

10.雅加达法塔西拉博物馆

最新推荐的是雅加达法塔西拉博物馆，即雅加达历史博物馆，位于雅加达老城，成立于1974年，前身是1710年的巴达维亚市政厅。该博物馆描绘了雅加达从前殖民时期到现代的历史，设有史前室、雅加达室、殖民室、独立室、现代室和地下监狱等房间。

门票成人 5,000 印尼盾，学生 3,000 印尼盾，学生 2,000 印尼盾，开放时间为周二至周日 09:00-15:00 WIB。设施包括停车场、卫生间、食堂、会议室和纪念品商店，建议您提前到达、穿着舒适的衣服、带上饮用水，并在可能的情况下使用导游。

那么，各位伙伴与朋友们 已经决定去哪里度假了吗？不用出国，印尼也很美！

原文来源：www.goersapp.com

A cheap holiday destination in Indonesia? It's really mandatory for you to know this and note it down to make it easier for you to travel to cities with the most beautiful tourist attractions.

Offers many amazing vacation spots that won't break the bank. For those of you who want to explore the beauty of this country without spending a lot of money, below are recommendations for the 10 newest cheap holiday spots in Indonesia, you know!

From stunning beaches to historic cities, these destinations offer an unforgettable holiday experience at an affordable cost. Let's start your frugal adventure and discover the charming charm of Indonesia!

Recommendations for Cheap Vacation Spots in Indonesia

1. Ciherang Waterfall, Bogor

The first recommendation for a cheap and beautiful holiday spot is Curug Ciherang, located in Wargajaya Village, Sukamakmur District, Bogor Regency, West Java, an amazing natural tourist destination with an entrance ticket price of only IDR 30,000 per person.

Apart from enjoying the beauty of the waterfall, visitors can enjoy various rides such as the Tree House, Suspension Bridge, Natural Swimming Pool, Camping Ground, and Instagrammable photo spots, you know! Ciherang Waterfall is open every day from 07.00 to 18.00 WIB, making it an ideal place for a refreshing and affordable short holiday.

2. Panguk Kediwung Hill, Yogyakarta

Next, Panguk Kediwung Hill in Mangunan Village, Dlingo District, Bantul Regency, Yogyakarta, is a natural tourist destination that offers stunning views of the sunrise.

With an entrance ticket of IDR 5,000 per person, visitors can enjoy various Instagrammable photo spots, light trekking paths and relaxing areas.This hill is open every day from 04.00 to 18.00 WIB, making it an ideal place to enjoy the natural beauty of Yogyakarta at an affordable cost.

3. Mangunan Pine Forest, Yogyakarta

This cheap tourist recommendation comes again from the same area as before, namely Yogyakarta. Mangunan Pine Forest in Yogyakarta is a popular destination that offers a cool atmosphere and the natural beauty of pine forests.

With an entrance ticket of IDR 5,000 – IDR 10,000 per person, visitors can enjoy the observation hill with expansive forest views, as well as Instagrammable photo spots. There are also rides such as a flying fox and facilities for outbound and camping grounds.

Mangunan Pine Forest is open every day with flexible operating hours, ideal for enjoying the cool morning or evening atmosphere.

4. Batu Square, Malang

Alun-Alun Batu Malang is a popular tourist destination in Malang, East Java.This place is free to visit and open 24 hours every day. The rides available include a Ferris Wheel, Carousel, Dancing Fountain, Children's Playground, Skate Park, and Culinary Area. B

Some rides have operating hours from 09.00 to 21.00 WIB. Other facilities available include toilets, seating and parking areas. Alun-Alun Batu Malang is suitable for visiting with family and friends.

5. Goa Cina Beach, Malang

This recommendation is at Goa Cina Beach in Malang, East Java, famous for its natural views and historical caves. Entrance ticket is around IDR 10,000 per person. The rides and activities available include cave exploration, snorkeling, swimming, enjoying the sunset, camping, fishing and photography. This beach is open 24 hours every day.

Facilities include toilets, bathrooms, food stalls, parking area, as well as snorkeling and camping equipment rental. This beach is suitable for holidays with family or friends.

6. Sadranan Beach, Gunung Kidul

Next, there is Sadranan Beach in Gunung Kidul, Yogyakarta, famous for its white sand and clear sea water. Entrance ticket is around IDR 10,000 to IDR 15,000 per person.

Available activities include snorkeling, swimming, banana boating, canoeing, camping and photography. This beach is open 24 hours every day, with facilities such as toilets, bathrooms, food stalls, rental of snorkeling equipment and camping equipment, as well as a parking area.This beach is suitable for holidays with family or friends.

7. Beratan Lake, Bali

This recommendation for cheap tourism in Indonesia is Lake Beratan in Bedugul, Bali. Famous for its mountain views and cool air. Entrance ticket is around IDR 20,000 to IDR 50,000 per person.

Available activities include visits to Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, traditional boat and speed boat rentals, canoeing, fishing, camping and photography. This lake is open every day from 08.00 to 18.00 WITA. Facilities include toilets, bathrooms, food stalls, restaurants, parking areas and souvenir shops. This destination is suitable for a family or friends holiday.

8. Kuta Beach, Lombok

Furthermore, Kuta Lombok Beach is a famous destination in West Nusa Tenggara with white sand and clear water. There is no entrance fee, but there is a parking fee of IDR 5,000 to IDR 10,000.

Available activities include surfing, snorkeling, swimming, horse riding, playing in the sand, picnicking and photography.This beach is open 24 hours every day. Facilities include toilets, bathrooms, food stalls, cafes, snorkeling and surfing equipment rental, parking area, and accommodation around the beach. This beach is suitable for holidays with family or friends.

9. Pari Island, Seribu Islands

Next is Pari Island, one of the interesting destinations in the Thousand Islands of Jakarta, offering a holiday experience that is one with nature. Visitors can enjoy the underwater beauty through snorkeling and diving activities.

There are various water rides such as banana boats and jet skis that can be enjoyed, as well as the opportunity to explore the island by bicycle or on foot.

Entrance ticket prices vary between IDR 50,000 to IDR 100,000 per person, with operating hours from morning to evening every day. Pari Island is the right choice for an exciting and refreshing holiday amidst unspoiled nature.

10. Fatahillah Museum Jakarta

The latest recommendation is the Jakarta Fatahillah Museum, or Jakarta History Museum, in the Old City of Jakarta, founded in 1974 with the former Batavia City Hall from 1710.This museum depicts the history of Jakarta from pre-colonial to modern with a collection of rooms such as Pre-Historic, Jayakarta, Colonial, Independence, Modern, and Underground Prison.

The entry ticket is IDR 5,000 for adults, IDR 3,000 for students, and IDR 2,000 for students, open Tuesday-Sunday 09.00-15.00 WIB.Facilities include a parking area, toilets, canteen, meeting room, and souvenir shop, with tips to arrive early, wear comfortable clothing, bring drinking water, and make use of a tour guide if available.

Well, Friends of Asia Plastik has decided where to go on holiday? No need to go abroad, Indonesia is also beautiful!

为什么印度尼西亚不下雪？答案是因为印度尼西亚靠近赤道。  除此之外，印度尼西亚没有下雪也可以用地理和气候因素来解释。 印度尼西亚的几个山区海拔足够高，气温相对温暖，属于热带气候条件。这些条件往往会阻碍积雪的形成或维持。

为什么没有下雪？

引自书中百科全书，Ahmad（2019：255），雪实际上和雨几乎一样，即与天上落水一样。只有非常冷的空气温度才会使其变成雪粒或晶体。
 
印度尼西亚本身许多地区的主要降水形式往往是降雨。以下几个原因可以解释为什么印度尼西亚没有下雪。

1.地理位置

印度尼西亚位于热带地区和赤道。所以大部分地区都靠近赤道。这个热带地区全年气候温暖。 因此季节性差异不太显着。降雪通常发生在气候温和或寒冷的地区。

2.地形和海拔

印度尼西亚大部分领土由地势相对较低的岛屿组成。这些低海拔地区无法承受积雪形成和维持所需的极冷温度。
 
 

3.温暖的海面温度

印度尼西亚周围的海洋环境温度趋于温暖。这些条件会影响周围空气的温度，并阻止温度低到足以形成或维持雪。
 
 

4.空气湿度高

印度尼西亚的空气湿度很高，尤其是因为它靠近大海。这种湿气会导致水凝结成雨，而不是形成雪晶。

5.季风模式

印度尼西亚典型的季风风型也发挥着重要作用。从印度洋吹来的季风将潮湿的空气带入内陆，导致降雨而不是降雪。
这些解释可以解释为什么印度尼西亚不下雪。希望以上的解释能够拓宽各位伙伴与朋友们的视野。

Why is there no snow in Indonesia? The answer is because Indonesia is near the equator.  Apart from that, the absence of snow in Indonesia can also be explained by geographical and climatic factors. Several mountainous areas in Indonesia have sufficient heights, relatively warm temperatures, and tropical climate conditions.These conditions tend to prevent the formation or maintenance of snow cover.

Why Is There No Snow?

Quoted from the bookEncyclopedia, Ahmad (2019: 255), snow is actually almost the same as rain, namely the same as falling water from the sky.Only very cold air temperatures cause it to become snow grains or crystals.
 
Indonesia itself tends to experience rain as the main form precipitation in many areas. Here are several reasons that can explain why there is no snow in Indonesia.

1. Geographic Location

Indonesia is located in the tropical region and equator.So most of the area is close to the equator. This tropical area tends to have a warm climate all year round. So the seasonal differences are less significant. Snow usually occurs in areas that have a temperate or cold climate.

2. Topography and Altitude

Most of Indonesia's territory consists of islands with relatively low topography.These low elevations do not support the very cold temperatures necessary for the formation and maintenance of snow cover.
 
 

3. Warm Sea Surface Temperatures

The marine environment around Indonesia tends to have a temperature warm one.These conditions affect the temperature of the surrounding air and prevent temperatures low enough to form or maintain snow.
 
 

4. High Air Humidity

Indonesia has high air humidity, especially because of its location near the sea.This moisture can cause the water to condense into rain rather than forming snow crystals.

5. Monsoon Wind Patterns

The typical monsoon wind pattern in Indonesia is also play an important role. Monsoon winds blowing from the Indian Ocean bring moist air inland, causing rain instead of snow.
Those are some explanations that can explain why in Indonesia no snow. Hopefully the explanation above can broaden Friends of Asia Plastik's insight.

圣诞节庆祝活动即将到来，如果餐桌上没有典型的圣诞饼干，那就感觉不太喜庆了。通常，有几种蛋糕确实是十二月假期的代名词。正如 Asia Plastik 推荐的那样，在家里享受圣诞节庆祝活动的同时，享用糕点可以成为晚餐后搭配热饮的美味小吃！

1。姜饼或姜饼

图片来源：Pixabay

形状酷似人偶的姜饼几乎就是圣诞节的代名词。这个蛋糕和普通饼干很像，但是里面加了姜。在一些国家，还有人在蛋糕中添加小豆蔻来增加香料。

质地有点稠，所以有时人们会把它浸入茶、咖啡或牛奶等热饮中来享用。蛋糕里的姜吃起来有一种温暖的感觉。

2。糖霜饼干

图片来源：Pixabay

糖霜饼干实际上是香草饼干，上面装饰着糖霜。糖霜易于成型的特性使这些典型的圣诞饼干增添了节日气氛。

这款蛋糕可以做成圣诞树、圣诞装饰品、人偶、袜子、铃铛、丝带等形状。质地酥脆，中间稍软。糖衣的甜味比干蛋糕本身更占主导地位。

因为制作起来非常简单，并且可以根据口味进行装饰，所以制作糖霜饼干通常是与家人一起迎接圣诞节的一项有趣活动。

3。黄油饼干

图片来源：Pixabay

黄油饼干是黄油饼干，质地松脆而柔软。其特点是黄油的香气，入口即化。这种蛋糕很常见，形状也很独特。

其实超市里已经有即食蛋糕出售，味道也相当不错。不过，黄油较多的蛋糕需要存放在密闭的容器中，以免轻易变软。

4。卡斯滕格尔

图片来源：Flickr

Kastengel 是一种典型的圣诞饼干，在全年的其他庆祝活动中经常出现。这个蛋糕是用面粉和黄油制成的，里面还添加了美味的奶酪。在上面撒上磨碎的切达干酪，为蛋糕增添了松脆的质感。

一般来说，这款蛋糕的形状是长方形的，但不厚。但并不罕见，形状也有新月形、星星形或花朵形。在其他甜蛋糕中，kaastengel 通常是最受欢迎的，因为它的味道往往是咸味的。

5。香草基普菲尔

图片来源：Pixabay

一看形状，你绝对能猜到这是什么蛋糕。是的，在印度尼西亚，vanillekipferl 更广为人知的名字是雪公主蛋糕。用于制作这种典型圣诞饼干的面粉通常与杏仁粉或花生粉混合。通常，还会添加细花生屑。因此，坚果具有美味的质地和味道。

这个月牙饼有点厚。烘烤完成后，蛋糕上涂上白糖粉。虽然加了糖，但吃起来并不会太甜。

Christmas celebrations are coming soon and it doesn't feel very festive without typical Christmas cookies on your table. Usually, there are several cakes that are truly synonymous with the holiday which falls in December. Serving pastries can be a delicious snack to eat with a warm drink after dinner while enjoying Christmas celebrations at home as recommended by Asia Plastik!

1. Ginger Cookies or Ginger Cake

Photo source: Pixabay

Ginger cakes with their shape that resemble human dolls are quite synonymous with Christmas. This cake is similar to ordinary cookies, but with the addition of ginger in it. In some countries, there are also those who add cardamom to add spice to the cake.

The texture is a little dense, so sometimes people enjoy this cake by dipping it in warm drinks such as tea, coffee or milk. The ginger in the cake gives a warm sensation when eaten.

2.Sugar Icing Cookies

Photo source: Pixabay

Sugar icing cookies are actually vanilla cookies decorated with sugar icing on top. The easy-to-form nature of sugar icing makes these typical Christmas cookies add to the festive atmosphere.

This cake can be made in the shape of a Christmas tree, Christmas decorations, human dolls, socks, bells, ribbons, and many others. The texture is crispy and slightly soft in the middle.The sweet taste is more dominant from the sugar icing than the dry cake itself.

Because it is quite easy to make and can be decorated according to taste, making sugar icing cookies is often a fun activity with the family to welcome Christmas.

3. Butter Cookies

Photo source: Pixabay

Butter cookies are butter cookies that have a crunchy yet soft texture. Its characteristic is the aroma of butter and it melts when it enters the mouth. This cake is quite common and has a distinctive shape.

In fact, there are already ready-to-eat cakes sold in supermarkets that taste quite good. However, cakes with a lot of butter need to be stored in a tight container so they don't get soft easily.

4. Kaastengel

Photo source: Flickr

Kastengel is a typical Christmas cookie that is often found at every other celebration throughout the year. This cake is made from flour and butter, with the addition of delicious cheese in it. On top it is sprinkled with grated cheddar cheese which adds a crunchy texture to the cake.

Generally, the shape of this cake is rectangular but not thick. But not infrequently, the shape is also in the shape of a crescent moon, star or flower.Among other sweet cakes, kaastengel is often the favorite because its taste tends to be salty and savory.

5. Vanillekipferl

Photo source: Pixabay

At a glance at the shape, you can definitely guess what kind of cake this is. Yes, in Indonesia, vanillekipferl is more familiarly known as snow princess cake.The flour used to make this typical Christmas cookie is often mixed with almond flour or peanut flour. Not infrequently, fine peanut crumbs are also added to it. So, there is a delicious texture and taste from the nuts.

This crescent moon-shaped cake is a little thick. After it is finished baking, the cake is coated with white sugar flour. Even though it's covered in sugar, it doesn't taste too sweet.

柠檬属于柑橘类水果。味酸，呈亮黄色，呈椭圆形，直径5～7厘米，末端凸起。

柠檬含有多种营养物质，可以改善身体和皮肤健康。其中包括维生素 C、水、蛋白质、纤维、镁、钾和钙。

它对皮肤的好处，即提亮和去除痤疮疤痕和黑头。其中的各种成分还可以有效维持口腔健康、预防心脏病。

柠檬营养成分

柠檬含有多种对身体和皮肤健康有益的营养素。

下面列出的数字是 ½ 杯或约 100 克去皮生柠檬中所含的营养成分：

  • 卡路里：29 卡路里。
  • 水：89%。
  • 蛋白质：1.1克。
  • 碳水化合物：9.3 克。
  • 糖：2.5克。
  • 纤维：2.8 克。
  • 脂肪：0.3克

除此之外，柠檬还含有许多其他重要的营养成分，例如：

  • 纤维。柠檬中的果胶等可溶性纤维含量有助于降低血糖水平。因为它可以减缓糖和淀粉的消化。 
  • 维生素。例如，维生素C和维生素B6可以提高人体免疫力，维持心脏健康，并将食物转化为能量。
  • 柠檬酸作为天然收敛剂，因为它可以收缩毛孔并控制油脂产生。 
  • 镁 有效平滑肌肤、延缓衰老、保护皮肤细胞免受自由基侵害。 
  • 钾 具有刺激中枢神经系统、对抗自由基、增加血细胞形成和调节血压的作用。 
  • 植物化合物，例如柠檬中的橙皮苷、圣草次苷和 D-柠檬烯，有助于预防癌症、心脏病和炎症。除此之外，它还可以缓解胃部问题，例如胃灼热和反流

柠檬对健康的好处

柠檬含有多种营养成分，可为您的皮肤和身体带来许多好处，包括：

1。帮助提亮肤色

柠檬富含维生素 C 和柠檬酸，可作为皮肤美白剂。该内容物起到去除死皮细胞的作用，从而刺激新皮肤细胞的再生。

维生素C的营养成分还可以对抗自由基、淡化色素沉着、均匀面部肤色。

2.去除粉刺和黑头

柠檬是一种健康食品，含有抗菌和抗真菌特性，有助于治疗痤疮和黑头。

为此，请将果肉涂抹在有问题的皮肤区域。等待 5 到 10 分钟，然后用水冲洗。

3.淡化黑斑和疤痕

柠檬还可以帮助淡化黑斑和疤痕。因为这种水果中含有柠檬酸。  柠檬酸是一种化合物，可以帮助更快地去除死皮细胞。  通过更快的去角质过程，皮肤将刺激新的、更健康的皮肤细胞的生长。

4。预防心脏病和糖尿病

其中所含的d-柠檬烯形式的抗氧化剂可有效降低患心脏病和2型糖尿病的风险。这种水果可以增加酶的活性，从而减少导致疾病的氧化应激。

5。有助于预防感染

柠檬含有多种抗菌和抗真菌营养素。

这些成分的两种特性都可以显着破坏和减少导致皮肤感染的抗生素耐药细菌的生长。

6。减肥

经常喝柠檬水是减肥的好习惯。 

根据临床营养研究杂志上的一项研究，在进食前喝柠檬水的研究小组或受试者比不喝柠檬水的人吃得更少。

7。预防肾结石

吃这种水果可以帮助您避免出现肾结石。柠檬中含有柠檬酸，可以通过增加尿量和提高尿液 pH 值来预防肾结石。

8。预防贫血

当身体缺乏铁时，这种情况会引发红细胞生成中断，从而导致贫血。食用它可以优化对维生素 C 的需求，维生素 C 有助于铁的吸收，从而使红细胞的生成更加优化。

9。改善消化健康

由于其高抗氧化剂含量，柠檬的下一个好处是改善消化健康。尝试在早上饮用与温水混合的果汁。 据报道，这种方法可以通过帮助克服便秘来改善消化健康。

10。降低患癌症的风险

柠檬中的柠檬烯和柚皮素等植物化合物可以降低患癌症的风险。因为这两种植物化合物具有抗癌作用。

据生物医学与生物技术杂志报道，这两种化合物还能够预防恶性肿瘤。 尤其是引发舌癌、肺癌和结肠癌的恶性肿瘤。

11。提高人体免疫系统

这种水果中的维生素C可以优化人体的免疫系统。当你身体的免疫系统处于最佳状态时，你当然会避免各种健康问题。

Lemons are included in the citrus fruit group. It has a sour taste, is bright yellow in color, and has an oval shape with a diameter of 5 to 7 centimeters (cm) with a bulge at the end.

Lemons contain various nutrients that can improve body and skin health. Some of them are vitamin C, water, protein, fiber, magnesium, potassium and calcium.

Its benefits for the skin, namely brightening and removing acne scars and blackheads.The various ingredients in it are also effective in maintaining oral health and preventing heart disease.

Lemon Nutrition Content 

Lemons contain various nutrients for body and skin health.

The numbers listed below are the nutrients contained in ½ cup or about 100 grams of peeled raw lemon:

  • Calories: 29 kilocalories.
  • Water: 89 percent.
  • Protein: 1.1 grams.
  • Carbohydrates: 9.3 grams.
  • Sugar: 2.5 grams.
  • Fiber: 2.8 grams.
  • Fat: 0.3 grams

Apart from that, lemons also contain many other important nutritional contents, such as:

  • Fiber. The soluble fiber content such as pectin in lemons can help lower blood sugar levels. Because it can slow down the digestion of sugar and starch. 
  • Vitamins.For example, vitamin C and vitamin B6 increase the body's immunity, maintain heart health, and convert food into energy.
  • Citric acid Acts as a natural astringent, because it can shrink pores and control oil production. 
  • Magnesium Effective for smoothing the skin, slowing down aging, and protecting skin cells from free radicals. 
  • Potassium Plays a role in stimulating the central nervous system, fighting free radicals, increasing blood cell formation, and regulating blood pressure. 
  • Plant compounds Such as hesperidin, eriocitrin, and D-limonene in lemons have benefits in preventing cancer, heart disease, and inflammation. Apart from that, it also relieves stomach problems such as heartburn and reflux

Benefits of Lemon for Health

From its many nutritional contents, there are a number of benefits of lemon that you can get for your skin and body, including:

1. Helps brighten skin

Lemons are high in vitamin C and citric acid which act as skin lightening agents. This content plays a role in removing dead skin cells, thus stimulating the regeneration of new skin cells.

The nutritional content of vitamin C can also fight free radicals, fade hyperpigmentation, and even out facial skin tone.

2. Removes acne and blackheads

Lemon is a healthy food that contains antibacterial and antifungal properties to help treat acne and blackheads.

To do this, apply the flesh of the fruit to the problem skin area. Wait and stay for 5 to 10 minutes then rinse with water.

3. Fades dark spots and scars

Lemon can also help fade black spots and scars.Because this fruit contains citric acid.  Well, citric acid is a compound that plays a role in helping the process of exfoliating dead skin cells more quickly.  With a faster exfoliation process, the skin will stimulate the growth of new, healthier skin cells.

4. Prevents heart disease and diabetes

The antioxidant in the form of d-limonene contained in it is effective in reducing the risk of heart disease and type 2 diabetes.This fruit can increase enzyme activity which can reduce oxidative stress that causes disease.

5. Helps prevent infection

Lemons contain several nutrients that are antimicrobial and antifungal.

Both properties of these ingredients can significantly damage and reduce the growth of antibiotic-resistant bacteria that cause skin infections.

6. Lose weight

Consuming lemon water regularly is a good habit for losing weight. 

According to a study in the journal Clinical Nutrition Research, research groups or subjects who consumed lemon water before consuming food were shown to eat less than those who did not consume it.

7. Prevent kidney stones

Eating this fruit can help you avoid the appearance of kidney stones.Lemon contains citric acid which can prevent kidney stones by increasing urine volume and increasing urine pH.

8. Prevent anemia

When the body lacks iron, this condition triggers disruption in red blood cell production which causes anemia. Consuming it optimizes the need for vitamin C which can help absorb iron, so that red blood cell production becomes more optimal.

9. Improves digestive health

Thanks to its high antioxidant content, the next benefit of lemon is improving digestive health. Try consuming the juice mixed with warm water in the morning. Reportedly, this method can improve digestive health by helping to overcome constipation.

10. Reduces the risk of cancer

Plant compounds, such as limonene and naringenin in lemons can reduce the risk of cancer.Because these two plant compounds have anticancer effects.

Reporting from the Journal of Biomedicine and Biotechnology, these two compounds are also able to prevent malignant tumors. Especially malignant tumors that trigger cancer of the tongue, lungs and colon.

11. Improves the body's immune system

Vitamin C in this fruit can optimize the body's immune system.When your body's immune system is in optimal condition, of course you will avoid various health problems.

lada-hitam-dan-lada-putih-serupa-tapi-ta.zh:
Pepper 是他们的另一个起点。一般来说，胡椒是用来增加辛辣味的，拌入烹饪中也有温热的作用。在所有种类的胡椒中，有一些在世界上非常受欢迎，即白胡椒和黑胡椒。

但不幸的是，不少人仍然对黑胡椒和白胡椒的区别感到困惑和错误。如果您是其中之一，这次我们将帮助您了解黑胡椒和白胡椒的区别。

这是黑胡椒和白胡椒之间的区别

1.白胡椒和黑胡椒来自相同的种子

您可能认为白胡椒和黑胡椒来自两种不同类型的植物。然而，事实上这两种黑胡椒来自同一种植物。黑胡椒是胡椒植物的果实。 

同时，白胡椒是胡椒植物的种子。为了制作黑胡椒，农民通常会采摘尚未成熟或尚未成熟的胡椒。然后，他们将其在阳光下晒干，直到辣椒果实变得皱纹和黑色。 

这种胡椒可以作为黑胡椒用于烹饪。同时，白胡椒是从胡椒果实内的种子中提取的。然后将采摘下来的水果浸泡并清洗几次。

化学过程用于获取辣椒种子。种子晒干后颜色就变成白色了，当然和果实晒黑了不一样。

2.西式烹饪中使用黑胡椒，亚洲烹饪中使用白胡椒

常用于西式菜肴，如烤肉、煎蛋卷、面食等菜肴。同时，白胡椒更广泛地应用于亚洲美食，包括印尼美食。

3.黑胡椒比白胡椒辣

黑胡椒的加工过程很简单，所以速度还是很强的，使得味道比白胡椒更辣。因为经过了多道清洗和浸泡阶段，白胡椒的味道变得更加温和

4.黑胡椒比白胡椒保质期更长

如果储存的话，黑胡椒的保存时间比白胡椒长。您可以将完好无损的保留一年。黑胡椒粉只能保存几个月。 

同时，经过多道图像处理的白胡椒在储存时更容易蒸发。因此，最好不要存储太多白色，这样就不会在存储过程中浪费它。

5.黑胡椒提味，白胡椒温补

通常黑胡椒用于增强食物的味道。同时，白胡椒通常用于给菜肴带来温暖的效果。因此，白胡椒非常适合您在汤等汤类菜肴中使用

Pepper is another start from them. Generally, pepper is used to add a spicy taste and also has a warming effect when mixed into cooking. Among all types of pepper, there are those that are very popular in the world, namely white pepper and black pepper.

But unfortunately, quite a few people are still confused and mistaken about the difference between black pepper and white pepper.If you are one of those people, on this occasion we will help you to know the difference between black pepper and white pepper.

This is the Difference Between Black Pepper and White Pepper 

1. White Pepper and Black Pepper come from the same seeds

You might think that white pepper and black pepper come from two different types of plants. However, in fact the two types of black pepper come from the same plant. Black pepper is the fruit of the pepper plant. 

Meanwhile, white pepper is the seed of the pepper plant. To make black pepper, farmers usually pick pepper that is still green or not yet ripe. Then, they dry it in the sun until the pepper fruit becomes wrinkled and black. 

This pepper is then used as black pepper for cooking. Meanwhile, white pepper is taken from the seeds inside the pepper fruit. The fruit that has been picked is then soaked and washed several times.

Chemical processes are used to obtain pepper seeds. The seeds are then dried in the sun and their color turns white, of course not the same as fruit which turns black when dried.

2.Black pepper is used in Western cooking and white pepper in Asian cooking

Usually used in western dishes such as grilled meat, omelets, pasta and other dishes. Meanwhile, white pepper is more widely used in Asian cuisine, including Indonesian food.

3. Black pepper is spicier than white pepper

The process of processing black pepper is very simple so the speed is still very strong, making the taste spicier than white pepper. Because it has gone through a number of washing and soaking stages, the taste of white pepper becomes milder

4. Black pepper lasts longer than white pepper

If stored, black pepper can last longer than white pepper. You can keep the ones that are still intact for one year.Ground black pepper can only last for a few months. 

Meanwhile, white pepper, which has gone through many stages of image processing, will evaporate more easily when stored. Therefore, it's a good idea not to store too much white so you don't waste it in storing it.

5. Black pepper enhances the taste and white pepper provides a warming effect

Usually black pepper is used to enhance the taste of food. Meanwhile, white pepper is generally used to give a warm effect to dishes. For this reason, white pepper is very suitable for you to use in soupy dishes such as soup

So that's the difference between White Pepper and Black Pepper.For the pepper packaging, make sure you use the Spice Jar packaging from Asia Plastik! Please contact us for further information and don't hesitate, Friends of Asia Plastik.

因此，需要强大的免疫系统来应对极端天气。建立强大的免疫系统的方法有很多，从采取健康的生活方式、吃营养食品、充足的睡眠到服用补充剂或维生素。经常食用维生素被认为是满足维生素需求和增强人体免疫力所必需的。

Uncertain weather changes such as heavy rain in the morning and then scorching heat in the afternoon can certainly have an impact on health. Very rapid weather changes can affect the human immune system and can even trigger the body to become more susceptible to disease. The reason is that rapid changes in weather often require the body to be able to adapt to accept changes in temperature quickly too.

Therefore, a strong immune system is needed to face extreme weather. There are many ways you can build a strong immune system, starting from adopting a healthy lifestyle, eating nutritious food, getting enough sleep to taking supplements or vitamins. Regular consumption of vitamins is considered necessary to meet vitamin needs and increase the body's immunity.

There are lots of vitamins that are useful for the body, such as vitamin A, vitamin B6, vitamin C and vitamin D. But Friends of Asia Plastik should know, the most suitable vitamin to consume during the rainy season is vitamin C! Why vitamin C?

In maintaining a healthy body, vitamin C plays a very important role, because vitamin C helps improve the body's immune system and acts as an antioxidant which plays a role in protecting the body from exposure to free radicals which can cause cell damage or inflammation in the body.

But unfortunately, the body is unable to produce vitamin C on its own, so eat healthy foods and take vitamin supplements if necessary.The reason is, a body that is deficient in vitamin C can cause the body to become more susceptible to exposure to pathogens that can trigger various diseases.

Some of the vitamins that have been mentioned are good vitamins to consume to maintain the body's immune system when the rainy season arrives. Apart from these vitamins, zinc can also help the body avoid exposure to pathogens that enter the body and trigger various health problems.

圣诞树是世界各地圣诞节庆祝活动的代名词。 这个传统已经延续了几个世纪，基督徒在家里放置圣诞树以营造独特的氛围。在这个庆祝活动中最常用的圣诞树类型是冷杉或松树，然后用各种装饰品进行装饰，例如彩球、铃铛、星星、丝带和灯光。

几乎所有基督徒都在不了解圣诞树的历史和真正含义的情况下履行这一传统。让今年的圣诞庆祝活动与众不同，让我们来看看圣诞树的历史以及各位伙伴与朋友们应该知道的意义。

圣诞树的历史以及它们与松树同义的原因

圣诞树的起源始于古埃及、古希腊和古罗马人民对松树的象征性使用。

根据历史页面，选择云杉或松树是因为这些树常年保持绿色，对人们的冬天有特殊的意义。

在欧洲许多国家，人们相信这棵树可以让家人远离女巫、邪灵、疾病和鬼魂。

在其他文化中，松树是永恒生命和生育力的象征。 

而其他种类的树木只在特定季节生长，只会提醒人类生死轮回。

第一个用圣诞树庆祝圣诞节的国家是16世纪的德国。 

圣诞树传统的传播开始增长，直到1800年代中期，这一传统开始传播到整个欧洲和美洲。

除了使用松树外，有些人还选择用木头建造圣诞金字塔，并用绿树和蜡烛装饰它们。

在看到树间天空中闪烁的星星的倒影后，马丁路德为第一棵圣诞树添加了蜡烛装饰品。

圣诞树的传统一直传播到维多利亚女王与德国阿尔伯特亲王结婚后，英国人开始使用圣诞树。

圣诞树的意义

目前，在家里摆放圣诞树的传统已经遍布世界各地。

每个国家对圣诞树的含义都有不同的看法。 

以下是圣诞树的含义：

1。古埃及人

在圣诞树传统存在之前，古埃及人相信绿色树枝的树意味着生命的胜利。

这要从古埃及人崇拜拉神的故事开始。 

病神拉有鹰头，皇冠上戴着太阳，就像一个燃烧的圆盘。

当拉神开始康复时，埃及人在家里种满了绿色的棕榈树，象征着生命战胜了死亡。

2。罗马人

圣诞树对罗马人的意义是纪念农业之神土星。

罗马人知道冬至意味着农场和种植园很快就会变得绿色和肥沃。

为了纪念这一事件，罗马人用绿色树枝装饰房屋和寺庙。

3。欧洲国家

对于欧洲人来说，松树枝是永恒生命的象征，因此德鲁伊和古代凯尔特祭司用松树枝装饰寺庙。

除了德鲁伊之外，斯堪的纳维亚地区以凶猛闻名的维京人也相信绿树是太阳神巴尔德的特殊植物。

4。德国

圣诞树传统最早是在德国进行的。然而，装饰树木的传统最早是由 16 世纪的新教改革家马丁·路德 (Martin Luther) 推行的，他在树顶添加了蜡烛。

据历史记载，马丁·路德在夜间行走时，一边写着布道文，一边被绿树丛中闪烁的星星迷住了。

为了恢复这种气氛，他最后在树顶添加了蜡烛，并将光缆连接到树枝的两端，使其看起来闪闪发光。

为了给家人重现这一场景，他在主房间里竖起了一棵树，并在树枝上点燃了蜡烛。

这就是圣诞树的意义、历史，以及松树成为圣诞树代名词的原因。

The Christmas tree is a symbol that is synonymous with Christmas celebrations throughout the world. This tradition has been going on for centuries where Christians place Christmas trees in their homes to create a unique atmosphere. The type of Christmas tree most commonly used during this celebration is a fir or pine tree which is then decorated with various ornaments such as colorful balls, bells, stars, ribbons and lights.

Almost all Christians carry out this tradition without knowing the history and true meaning of the Christmas tree. So that this year's Christmas celebration is different, let's look at the history of the Christmas tree and its meaning that Friends of Asia Plastik should know.

The History of Christmas Trees and the Reasons Why They Are Synonymous with Pine Trees

The origins of the Christmas tree begin with the symbolic use of pine trees among the people of Ancient Egypt, Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome.

According to the History page, the choice of spruce or pine trees was because these trees remain green all year round and have a special meaning for people in winter.

In many countries in Europe, this tree is believed to keep families away from witches, evil spirits, disease and ghosts.

In other cultures, the pine tree is a symbol of eternal life and fertility. 

Meanwhile, other types of trees that only live in certain seasons will only remind humans of the cycle of human life and death.

The first country to celebrate Christmas with a Christmas tree was Germany in the 16th century. 

The spread of the Christmas tree tradition began to grow until in the mid-1800s, this tradition began to spread throughout Europe and America.

In addition to using pine trees, some people choose to build Christmas pyramids made of wood and decorate them with green trees and candles.

The figure who added candle ornaments as decorations for the first Christmas tree was Martin Luther, after seeing the reflection of twinkling stars in the sky between the trees.

The tradition of Christmas trees spread until British people started using Christmas trees when Queen Victoria married Prince Albert of Germany.

The Meaning of Christmas Trees

Currently, the tradition of putting up Christmas trees in the house has spread throughout the world.

Each country has a different point of view regarding the meaning of the Christmas tree. 

The following is the meaning of the Christmas tree:

1. Ancient Egyptians

Before the Christmas tree tradition existed, the Ancient Egyptians believed that a tree with green branches meant victory in life.

This begins with the story of the Ancient Egyptians who worshiped a god called Ra. 

The sick god Ra had the head of an eagle and wore the sun as a flaming disc on his crown.

When the god Ra began to recover, the Egyptians filled their homes with green palm trees symbolizing the victory of life over death.

2. The Romans

The meaning of the Christmas tree for the Romans was to honor Saturn, the god of agriculture.

The Romans knew that the solstice meant that soon farms and plantations would become green and fertile.

To commemorate this event, the Romans decorated houses and temples with green branches.

3. European Nations

For Europeans, the branches of pine trees were a symbol of eternal life, so the Druids and ancient Celtic priests decorated temples with them.

Apart from the Druids, the Vikings who were known for being fierce in Scandinavia also believed that green trees were the special plants of the Sun god, Balder.

4. Germany

The Christmas tree tradition was first carried out in Germany.However, the tradition of decorating trees was first carried out by Martin Luther, a 16th century Protestant reformer who added candles to the tops of his trees.

According to history, Martin Luther, who was walking at night while writing a sermon, was fascinated by the sparkling stars amidst the green trees.

To restore that atmosphere, he finally added candles to the top of the tree and attached light cables to each end of the branches to make it look sparkling.

To recapture the scene for his family, he erected a tree in the main room and wired its branches with lit candles.

That is the meaning, history of Christmas trees, and the reasons why pine trees are synonymous with Christmas trees.

您是否注意到塑料回收包装上三角箭头中数字 1-7 形式的徽标或符号？这个符号不仅仅是装饰。符号中的每个数字都显示有关用于制造塑料包装的化学品及其安全级别的信息。

通过了解塑料包装上数字符号背后的含义，您可以确定哪种塑料包装可以安全使用，并了解塑料容器污染环境的可能性有多大。

1。 PET 或 PETE（聚乙烯对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯）#1

箭头三角形中带有数字 1 符号的塑料容器常见于食品和饮料包装中，例如矿泉水瓶、碳酸饮料瓶、果酱罐等。然而，尽管放置食物和饮料是安全的，但塑料容器 #1 仅建议使用一次。如果反复使用，尤其是装热饮，容器上的聚合物涂层会释放出致癌物质，引发癌症。

带有符号 #1 的包装可以回收制成地毯、拉菲草、手提袋，甚至纤维。回收的塑料废物#1也被分类为比具有其他数字符号的塑料废物更多。

2。HDPE（高密度聚乙烯）#2

HDPE 塑料包装或带有箭头三角形中的数字 2 符号的塑料包装可用于储存食物和饮料。原因是，这种塑料材料更耐高温且坚固。 HDPE 符号通常出现在特百惠、牛奶瓶、矿泉水加仑，甚至洗发水瓶上。

尽管这种塑料材料可以安全地存放食物和饮料，但只能使用一次。重复使用会引发三氧化二锑化合物的释放。使用 2 号塑料容器后，您应立即将此塑料回收到新的 HDPE 包装、地砖或管道中。

3。PVC（聚氯乙烯）#3

不建议使用 PVC 制成的塑料来包装食品和饮料，因为它非常危险。这种类型更常用于包装洗发水或烟斗。如果使用#3塑料容器来包装食品，其中的化学物质会增加患肝病和肾病的风险。

此类 PVC 塑料的回收过程相当困难，因为并非所有收集者都愿意处理这种塑料。 3 号塑料燃烧时会释放出氯。但是，如果您想继续回收#3 塑料废物，您可以将其回收到面板、垫子或挡泥板中。

4。LDPE（低密度聚乙烯）#4

LDPE 是一种由石油制成的塑料材料。因此，这种塑料被认为足以安全地储存食物和饮料。对于放置热食物和饮料，LDPE 塑料被认为是合适的，因为即使暴露在高温下，塑料层也不会熔化。回收LDPE塑料相当困难。但是，如果您仍然想回收这种塑料，可以将其转化为制作瓷砖和塑料袋的材料。

5。 PP（聚丙烯）#5

在众多类型的塑料中，带有箭头三角形中的数字 5 符号的塑料容器是最佳选择。您会在可以多次使用的食品容器或饮料瓶上找到这个符号。此类塑料的特点是强度大、重量轻、耐脂肪、高温下稳定。

当您想使用安全无害的塑料容器时，请寻找外部带有数字 5 的塑料容器。这种类型的塑料还可以回收制成勺子、叉子、扫帚和托盘。

6。 PS（聚苯乙烯）#6

PS 或箭头三角形中的数字 6 符号表示该塑料使用危险化学品。一般来说，这个符号经常出现在难以回收的聚苯乙烯泡沫塑料或塑料材料上。考虑到回收困难，此类塑料有可能污染环境。

PS 符号可以在 CD（光盘）、鸡蛋盒或一次性盘子上找到。即使这类塑料可以回收利用，PS塑料回收产生的物品也是泡沫包装、蛋盒和建筑保温材料。

7。其他（聚碳酸酯）#7

其他类别的塑料容器包括 4 种类型，即 SAN（苯乙烯丙烯腈）、ABS（丙烯腈丁二烯苯乙烯）、PC（聚碳酸酯）和尼龙。这种塑料材料用于制造电子设备、汽车零部件和其他设备。

这种塑料含有有毒的双酚 A (BPA)，会增加不孕和荷尔蒙失调的风险。不幸的是，尽管它很危险，但仍然有许多食品或饮料容器使用这种类型的塑料。

在使用塑料包装之前，应首先检查外部的数字符号。避免使用危险的塑料作为食品和饮料容器，以尽量减少健康问题。除此之外，尽量回收日常使用的包装或容器中的塑料，以减少环境污染的风险。

这就是塑料回收类别及其标志，各位伙伴与朋友们！ Asia Plastik 本身肯定使用安全、符合食品级标准、经过 ISO 和 HALAL 认证的塑料用于中小微企业和 各位伙伴与朋友们 行业的塑料包装。如果您需要塑料包装，请随时联系我们，各位伙伴与朋友们！
